summary: While WhisperX accelerates speech transcription via intra-audio batching, it isolates audio segments, losing the historical context needed for coherent punctuation and terminology transcription. Conversely, standard Whisper retains context sequentially but suffers from slow inference and hallucination loops. To achieve the best of both worlds, we propose Context-Aware Interleaved Batching. By using VAD-derived segment boundaries, our algorithm stabilizes Whisper's text conditioning, allowing us to safely maintain continuous historical context across batched audio segments. As demonstrated on long-form audio benchmarks, this approach reduces Word Error Rate (WER) and improves proper noun transcription, all while maintaining high-throughput inference speeds.
title: Context-Aware Interleaved Batching for WhisperX
title_translated: 面向WhisperX的上下文感知交错批处理
summary_translated: 尽管WhisperX通过音频内批处理加速了语音转录，但其将音频片段隔离，丢失了实现连贯标点和术语转录所需的历史上下文。相反，标准Whisper虽能保持顺序上下文，却面临推理缓慢和幻觉循环的问题。为兼顾两者优势，我们提出上下文感知交错批处理。通过使用基于语音活动检测（VAD）的分段边界，我们的算法稳定了Whisper的文本条件，使我们能够安全地在批处理的音频片段间维持连续的历史上下文。在长音频基准测试中，该方法降低了词错误率（WER），提升了专有名词转录效果，同时保持了高吞吐量的推理速度。

summary: BioMedRAG introduced retrieval-augmented generation with a learned chunk scorer for biomedical information extraction. However, it relies on fixed-size chunking which can fragment semantic evidence. We propose a configurable semantic chunking framework that addresses this limitation by combining entity-preserving windows, trigger-centered chunking, proposition-first extraction, tiered trigger prioritization, and hierarchical relation resolution. The framework integrates with BioMedRAG by replacing only the chunk construction stage while preserving the embedding model, learned chunk scorer, generator, and evaluation protocol. We evaluate the framework on biomedical relation extraction benchmarks (GM-CIHT, DDI, ChemProt) and adverse event classification (ADE). On GM-CIHT, the full hybrid configuration achieves 82.6% F1, improving over the fixed-size baseline (74.2% F1) by 8.4 points under our experimental setup. Cross-dataset analysis shows that semantic chunking improves extraction datasets with explicit relation cues, such as GM-CIHT and DDI, while fixed chunking remains competitive or stronger for dense biochemical extraction and binary classification settings such as ChemProt and ADE. By externalizing chunking logic into configuration files, the framework provides an interpretable and adaptable alternative to rigid fixed-size chunking for biomedical RAG pipelines.
title: Configurable Semantic Chunking for Biomedical Information Extraction in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_translated: 可配置的语义分块用于检索增强生成中的生物医学信息抽取
summary_translated: BioMedRAG引入了带有学习分块评分器的检索增强生成以支持生物医学信息抽取。然而，其依赖固定大小的分块方式，可能导致语义证据被碎片化。我们提出一种可配置的语义分块框架，通过结合保留实体的窗口、以触发词为中心的分块、命题优先抽取、分层触发优先级以及层级关系解析来解决这一问题。该框架仅替换分块构建阶段，保留嵌入模型、学习分块评分器、生成器和评估协议，与BioMedRAG无缝集成。我们在生物医学关系抽取基准（GM-CIHT、DDI、ChemProt）和不良事件分类（ADE）上进行了评估。在GM-CIHT上，完整混合配置达到82.6%的F1值，相比固定大小基线（74.2% F1）提升8.4个百分点。跨数据集分析表明，语义分块在具有明确关系线索的数据集（如GM-CIHT和DDI）上表现更优，而固定分块在密集生化抽取和二分类场景（如ChemProt和ADE）中仍具竞争力或更强。通过将分块逻辑外化为配置文件，该框架为生物医学RAG流水线提供了可解释且可适应的替代方案，取代僵化的固定大小分块。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer promising clinical decision support but remain vulnerable to hallucinated facts, unsupported recommendations, and citation errors. We present DIASENTINEL, a fully on-premise multi-agent system for one-year type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) risk screening and guideline-grounded report generation from electronic health records (EHRs). The system integrates calibrated risk prediction, deterministic clinical signal extraction, Reciprocal Rank Fusion over American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines, and a hybrid verification layer combining rule-based checks with LLM entailment. The demonstration provides a real-time batch-screening dashboard and an interactive patient report interface with cited recommendations, verification results, and raw EHR comparison. DIASENTINEL demonstrates a practical framework for reliable, auditable, and privacy-preserving LLM-based clinical decision support.
title: DIASENTINEL: An Auditable Multi-Agent System for Guideline-Grounded Diabetes Risk Screening
title_translated: DIASENTINEL：用于指南驱动糖尿病风险筛查的可审计多智能体系统
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在临床决策支持方面展现出巨大潜力，但仍易产生幻觉事实、无依据建议和引用错误。我们提出DIASENTINEL，一个完全本地部署的多智能体系统，用于一年期2型糖尿病（T2DM）风险筛查及从电子健康记录（EHRs）中生成基于指南的报告。该系统整合了校准的风险预测、确定性的临床信号提取、美国糖尿病协会（ADA）指南的互惠排名融合，以及结合规则检查与LLM蕴含判断的混合验证层。演示展示了实时批量筛查仪表板和交互式患者报告界面，包含引用建议、验证结果和原始EHR对比。DIASENTINEL展示了一个可靠、可审计且隐私保护的基于LLM的临床决策支持实用框架。

summary: Research planning is the decisive capability of AI scientists. Yet a research plan admits no verifiable answer, so reinforcement learning lacks the environment it requires: tasks paired with a critic. Rubrics extracted from scientific papers can supply the critic. Existing pipelines, however, draw the question and the criteria from the same content, so the reward can be earned by paraphrase. The rubric is further compressed into a single scalar per rollout. We introduce PaperGym, a unified framework that turns each research paper into a complete training environment. PaperGym exploits the structure of a paper: the question is synthesized from the research goal and background, while the criteria are derived from the method and experiments. The criteria span methodological innovation and experimental design, and criterion leakage falls to 3.7%, versus 11.90% to 34.10% in existing datasets. Training uses the rubric twice: first as privileged context for OPSD's self-teacher, then as the reward for GRPO. Across Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B, this schedule outperforms supervised fine-tuning, either stage alone, and the reverse ordering, improving five-benchmark averages by +5.6, +5.0, and +4.8 points. With the recipe held fixed, models trained on PaperGym-20k win 58.1% of three-way comparisons, against 28.2% for RubricHub Science. The trained Qwen3-8B reaches 73.48 on ResearchQA, above the far larger Kimi K2.6. We release the pipeline, the 20,000-instance corpus PaperGym-20k, and the benchmarks PaperGym-Innov and PaperGym-Design.
title: PaperGym: Rubric-Centered Evolution for Research-Plan Generation

title_translated: PaperGym：以评分标准为中心的研究计划生成演化
summary_translated: 研究规划是AI科学家的核心能力。然而，研究计划并无可验证的答案，导致强化学习缺乏所需的环境：即任务与评判者配对。从科学论文中提取的评分标准可作为评判者。现有流程通常从同一内容中提取问题和标准，使得奖励可通过改写获得。此外，评分标准被压缩为每次推演的单一标量。我们引入PaperGym，一个统一框架，将每篇科研论文转化为完整的训练环境。PaperGym利用论文结构：问题由研究目标和背景合成，标准则来自方法和实验部分。标准涵盖方法创新与实验设计，标准泄露率降至3.7%，远低于现有数据集的11.90%至34.10%。训练过程中两次使用评分标准：首次作为OPS D的特权上下文进行自教师训练，第二次作为GRPO的奖励信号。在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B模型上，该策略优于监督微调、任一阶段单独训练以及反向顺序，五项基准平均得分分别提升+5.6、+5.0和+4.8。在固定训练配方下，PaperGym-20k训练的模型在三路比较中胜率为58.1%，高于RubricHub Science的28.2%。训练后的Qwen3-8B在ResearchQA上达到73.48分，超过更大规模的Kimi K2.6。我们发布了该流程、包含20,000个实例的语料库PaperGym-20k，以及基准PaperGym-Innov和PaperGym-Design。

summary: Many important forms of human learning begin with a vague goal, such as "become a better physicist" or "improve at research." Learners must interpret the goal, identify capability gaps, decide how to learn, and determine whether they have actually improved. In contrast, existing work on LLM self-evolution typically begins with tasks and evaluation metrics specified by humans, reducing self-evolution to optimizing an explicit objective rather than deciding what and how to learn. We introduce ASPIRE, a benchmark for vague-goal-driven self-evolution. ASPIRE provides only a natural-language capability goal while downstream evaluation tasks remain hidden. The agent must operationalize the goal by choosing data and update methods, constructing training and validation signals, and deciding when to evaluate. ASPIRE supports both model-weight and agent-harness evolution in a unified interactive environment and evaluates the resulting systems on a hidden, expert-authored set of 520 items spanning six goals. Our experiments show that vague goals redirect search effort toward goal interpretation. Current agents routinely complete training and harness-editing loops, but weight-level gains remain sparse and unstable, and the strongest evolved harness remains below the engineered Qwen-Agent reference. Agents often train on mismatched data and trust narrow self-evaluations, so local gains fail to transfer to hidden evaluation and continued search and training can erase earlier improvements.
title: Aspire: Can Models Self-Evolve from Vague Goals?
title_translated: Aspire：模型能否从模糊目标中自我演化？
summary_translated: 许多重要的人类学习形式始于模糊目标，例如“成为更好的物理学家”或“提升研究能力”。学习者必须解读目标、识别能力差距、决定如何学习，并判断是否真正进步。相比之下，现有的LLM自我演化研究通常以人类指定的任务和评估指标为起点，将自我演化简化为优化显式目标，而非决定学什么和如何学。我们提出ASPIRE，一个面向模糊目标驱动自我演化的基准测试。ASPIRE仅提供自然语言能力目标，下游评估任务则保持隐藏。智能体必须通过选择数据和更新方法、构建训练与验证信号、决定何时评估来具体化目标。ASPIRE在统一交互环境中支持模型权重与智能体架构的演化，并在包含6个目标的520项专家撰写的隐藏评估集上评估结果。实验表明，模糊目标引导搜索努力转向目标解读。当前智能体普遍完成训练与架构编辑循环，但权重层面的提升仍稀疏且不稳定，最强演化出的架构仍低于人工设计的Qwen-Agent基准。智能体常使用不匹配的数据进行训练，过度信任狭隘的自我评估，导致局部增益无法迁移到隐藏评估，持续的搜索与训练甚至可能抹去早期改进。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly interact with external environments and accumulate substantial behavioral experience, yet existing agent benchmarks largely evaluate them as fixed policies. It therefore remains unclear whether an agent can actively test its behavior, judge the resulting experience, and use that experience to improve future decisions. We introduce \textbf{S\textsuperscript{3}Gym}, an interactive benchmark for evaluating LLM self-improvement through three coupled capabilities: \textbf{Self-Testing}, \textbf{Self-Judging}, and \textbf{Self-Improvement}. S$^3$Gym separates permissive exploration from strict held-out evaluation and instantiates this protocol in seven text-based games with executable environment verifiers. We evaluate three pathways for incorporating interaction experience: direct History ICL, score-conditioned Summary Memory, and parameter Training.   Our experiments reveal that self-improvement is neither automatic nor uniform. Context-level experience improves performance for several model--game pairs, but the most effective pathway depends strongly on the task structure: summaries are beneficial when experience can be compressed into reusable strategic rules, yet often underperform raw history when success depends on precise, state-contingent information. Parameter training produces substantial gains on some tasks, but also exhibits unstable improvement and severe negative transfer on others. These findings show that recognizing successful actions is insufficient; agents must also transform feedback into executable and transferable policies. S$^3$Gym provides a unified framework for diagnosing this process and identifying the bottlenecks that prevent agents from translating interaction experience into reliable self-improvement.
title: S3Gym: Can LLMs Turn Self-Testing and Self-Judging into Self-Improvement?
title_translated: S3Gym：大语言模型能否将自我测试与自我评判转化为自我改进？
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地与外部环境交互并积累大量行为经验，但现有的智能体基准大多将它们视为固定策略进行评估。因此，尚不清楚智能体是否能够主动测试自身行为、判断由此产生的经验，并利用这些经验改进未来的决策。我们提出了	extbf{S	extsuperscript{3}Gym}，一个通过三种耦合能力评估LLM自我改进的交互式基准：	extbf{自我测试}、	extbf{自我评判}和	extbf{自我改进}。S$^3$Gym将宽松探索与严格保留评估分离，并在七个可执行环境验证器的文本游戏中实例化该协议。我们评估了三种融入交互经验的路径：直接历史提示学习（History ICL）、基于得分的摘要记忆以及参数训练。实验表明，自我改进既非自动也非均匀。上下文级经验提升了多个模型-游戏组合的表现，但最有效的路径强烈依赖于任务结构：当经验可压缩为可复用的战略规则时，摘要有益；而当成功依赖精确的状态相关信息时，原始历史往往表现更优。参数训练在某些任务上带来显著提升，但在其他任务上表现出不稳定的改进和严重的负迁移。这些发现表明，仅识别成功动作是不够的；智能体还必须将反馈转化为可执行且可迁移的策略。S$^3$Gym提供了一个统一框架，用于诊断这一过程并识别阻碍智能体将交互经验转化为可靠自我改进的瓶颈。

summary: The Jacobian Lens (J-lens) is a recent tool for interpreting LLMs. It reads a hidden state as a ranked list of vocabulary tokens, leaving multi-token concepts without a representation of their own. The original J-lens work addresses this limitation with Template Lens, which precomputes vectors for a fixed phrase vocabulary, and Oracle Lens, which fine-tunes components to propose phrases and reconstruct phrase vectors. We ask whether multi-token concepts and their vectors can instead be recovered directly from J-lens and the frozen model. We find that the first token of a multi-token concept is about as readable as a single-token concept. Given the correct first token and source prompt, the frozen model recovers the second token in 88.3% of two-token cases. We show that a vector for the complete concept can be recovered from subsequent hidden states in a single forward pass. We therefore use J-lens to propose first tokens and let the frozen model complete candidate concepts. We then recover a vector for each candidate and score it alongside the complete vocabulary. Across 496 multi-hop clozes on Gemma-3-12B-IT, Llama-3.1-8B, and Qwen3-14B, our method achieves an average $\mathrm{Rank@}10$ of 43.1%, compared with 27.6% for Template Lens. Without the J-lens clue, performance drops to 21.6%, showing that the first-token clue substantially improves readout. Causal concept swaps using the recovered vectors achieve an average $\mathrm{succ}@10$ of 61.4%, compared with 26.2% for Template Lens under the same intervention. These results show that first-token clues can guide multi-token concept recovery, while subsequent hidden states provide vectors for readout and intervention.
title: The First Token Is a Clue: Verbalizing Multi-Token Concepts from the J-lens
title_translated: 首个词是线索：从J-lens中提取多词概念的表述
summary_translated: 雅各布森透镜（J-lens）是最近用于解释大语言模型的工具。它将隐藏状态读作词汇标记的排序列表，但无法为多词概念提供独立表示。原始J-lens工作通过模板透镜（预计算固定短语词汇向量）和Oracle透镜（微调组件以提出短语并重建短语向量）来解决这一局限性。我们探讨是否可以不依赖额外训练，直接从J-lens和冻结模型中恢复多词概念及其向量。研究发现，多词概念的第一个词与单个词概念一样具有可读性。在给定正确首词和源提示的情况下，冻结模型在88.3%的双词情形中能恢复第二个词。我们证明，可通过一次前向传播从后续隐藏状态中恢复完整概念的向量。因此，我们使用J-lens提议首词，并让冻结模型完成候选概念。随后对每个候选概念恢复向量，并与完整词汇表一同评分。在Gemma-3-12B-IT、Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen3-14B上的496个多跳填空任务中，我们的方法平均达到$	ext{Rank@}10$为43.1%，优于模板透镜的27.6%。若无J-lens线索，性能降至21.6%，表明首词线索显著提升读出效果。使用恢复向量进行因果概念替换，在相同干预下平均$	ext{succ}@10$达61.4%，远超模板透镜的26.2%。结果表明，首词线索可引导多词概念恢复，而后续隐藏状态则提供可用于读出和干预的向量。

summary: Autonomous scientific research agents are increasingly applied to end-to-end scientific workflows, including literature review, data analysis, experimentation, and report generation. However, open-ended research tasks often do not clearly specify the analyses, methods, and success criteria required to complete the task. As a result, agents may miss important analyses, use inappropriate methods, or draw conclusions that are insufficiently supported by evidence. To address the problem, we present AutoSciRub, an evaluation-first framework that induces a task-specific executable rubric before research execution, and uses it to guide execution, criterion-level verification as well as iterative revision. AutoSciRub decomposes an underspecified instruction into atomic scientific goals, grounds them in relevant literature and task-visible data, and synthesizes specific, actionable, and verifiable criteria. The resulting rubric makes implicit experimental and evidential requirements explicit, providing guidance for experiments and analyses. During revision, rubric-guided verification identifies unmet criteria and enables targeted refinement of the research report and its supporting artifacts. On ResearchClawBench, AutoSciRub consistently improves all tested configurations, with an average gain of 2.08 points across three backbone LLMs under the fixed Codex harness and 2.95 points across three agent harnesses using a fixed DeepSeek-V4-Flash backbone. On a randomly sampled 20-task subset of AstaBench E2E Discovery, AutoSciRub further achieves an average improvement of 16.8 points across three agent harnesses, while maintaining or increasing the number of successfully completed tasks. These results demonstrate that evaluation-first guidance provides an effective and generalizable control mechanism for autonomous scientific research (Code: https://github.com/zjunlp/AutoSciRub).
title: Learning to Evaluate Before Improving: Automatic Rubric Induction for Automatic Research Agents
title_translated: 先评估再改进：面向自主科研智能体的自动评分标准生成
summary_translated: 自主科学科研智能体正被广泛应用于端到端科研流程，包括文献综述、数据分析、实验设计和报告生成。然而，开放式的科研任务通常未明确指定完成任务所需的分析方法、技术手段和成功标准。因此，智能体可能遗漏重要分析、使用不当方法，或得出缺乏充分证据支持的结论。为解决此问题，我们提出AutoSciRub——一种评估优先的框架，在科研执行前自动生成特定任务的可执行评分标准，并以此指导执行、进行层级验证及迭代修订。AutoSciRub将模糊指令分解为原子科学目标，将其与相关文献和任务可见数据相结合，合成具体、可操作且可验证的标准。生成的评分标准使隐含的实验与证据要求显性化，为实验和分析提供指导。在修订阶段，评分标准引导的验证可识别未满足的标准，从而实现对研究报告及其支撑材料的针对性优化。在ResearchClawBench上，AutoSciRub始终优于所有测试配置，固定Codex支架下三种骨干LLM平均提升2.08分，固定DeepSeek-V4-Flash骨干的三种智能体支架下平均提升2.95分。在AstaBench E2E Discovery的随机抽样20项任务子集上，AutoSciRub进一步实现三种智能体支架下平均提升16.8分，同时保持或增加成功完成的任务数量。结果表明，评估优先的引导机制为自主科学研究提供了有效且可泛化的控制方式。

summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves multi-step problem solving, but long reasoning traces inflate inference cost. Token-level CoT compression reduces this cost by pruning full reasoning chains into shorter traces for model adaptation, making token selection the central challenge. Existing methods often rely on external scorers or heuristic signals only indirectly tied to the model's internal answer computation. We instead adopt a model-internal perspective: as the model forms an answer, each reasoning token leaves a ripple in the residual stream, the model's \emph{stream of thought}, and the magnitude of this ripple reflects the token's contribution to the answer computation. Building on this view, we propose \textsc{MIST} (Model-Internal Saliency for Token-level CoT compression), which defines token importance along two complementary axes: \emph{necessity}, the drop in answer likelihood when a token's internal contribution is removed, and \emph{sufficiency}, the gain in answer likelihood when that contribution alone is provided. Combining the two yields a unified importance score for pruning. Across four reasoning benchmarks and four models, \textsc{MIST} consistently outperforms baseline methods, suggesting that model-internal saliency provides an effective proxy for reasoning-token importance.
title: Every Token Leaves a Ripple in the Stream of Thought: Eliciting Model-Internal Token Saliency for Chain-of-Thought Compression
title_translated: 每个词都在思维流中留下涟漪：用于链式思维压缩的模型内部词重要性挖掘
summary_translated: 链式思维（CoT）推理提升了多步问题求解能力，但长推理轨迹会增加推理成本。词级CoT压缩通过剪枝完整推理链为较短轨迹来降低该成本，使得词的选择成为核心挑战。现有方法通常依赖外部评分器或仅间接关联模型内部答案计算的启发式信号。我们转而采用模型内部视角：当模型形成答案时，每个推理词在残差流（即模型的“思维流”）中留下涟漪，其涟漪幅度反映了该词对答案计算的贡献程度。基于这一观点，我们提出	extsc{MIST}（模型内部重要性用于词级CoT压缩），从两个互补维度定义词的重要性：	extit{必要性}（移除某词内部贡献后答案概率的下降程度）和	extit{充分性}（仅提供该贡献时答案概率的提升程度）。两者结合生成统一的重要度评分以用于剪枝。在四个推理基准和四种模型上，	extsc{MIST}持续优于基线方法，表明模型内部重要性可作为推理词重要性的有效代理。

summary: When information extraction fails, a natural instinct is to improve the model doing it: for example, by scaling it up or refining its reasoning. In this paper, we show that another part of the pipeline matters at least as much: the queries used to elicit this information. Across four clinical benchmarks and five LLMs, improving the question design alone raises performance by 18.6 F1-score points, i.e. more than using larger extraction models. To make such question design learnable, we introduce List of Questions (LoQ), which generates document-specific question sets, and FeedQ, a feedback-driven optimization method that iteratively refines questions against extraction outcomes. The resulting optimized questions can be used to train lightweight generators: with fine-tuning, 4B-parameter models match or outperform expert-derived baselines and substantially exceed the performance of much larger untuned models. We release a dataset of 12,820 optimized questions to support a broader shift in information extraction research toward treating question design as a first-class problem.
title: Improving Information Extraction with Learned Queries
title_translated: 通过学习查询提升信息抽取性能
summary_translated: 当信息抽取失败时，人们自然倾向于改进执行抽取的模型：例如通过扩大规模或优化其推理过程。本文表明，流水线中的另一环节同样至关重要：用于诱发信息的查询设计。在四个临床基准和五个LLM上，仅改进问题设计即可使性能提升18.6 F1分数点，甚至超过使用更大规模抽取模型的效果。为使问题设计可学习，我们引入List of Questions（LoQ），生成文档相关的问答集合，并提出FeedQ——一种基于反馈的优化方法，通过迭代优化问题以匹配抽取结果。由此生成的优化问题可用于训练轻量级生成器：经微调后，4B参数模型的表现可媲美甚至超越专家制定的基线，且显著优于更大但未经调优的模型。我们发布了包含12,820个优化问题的数据集，以推动信息抽取研究范式转向将问题设计视为首要问题。

summary: Incremental Named Entity Recognition (INER) stands as a pivotal task in information extraction, emphasizing the successive identification of new entity types within unstructured text. Faced with the continuous influx of entity types, INER grapples with two significant challenges: the widespread issue of catastrophic forgetting and the unique shift issue of the non-entity type semantics. While pseudo-labeling-based INER methods have proven effective in addressing these challenges, a previously overlooked issue arises: the biased context problem. Our analysis shows that, in new sentences, the contextual associations of tokens representing old entity types exhibit a significantly stronger bias towards new entity types compared to their contexts in old sentences. This tendency intensifies the degradation of old knowledge while promoting the overfitting of new knowledge. To solve this biased context, we propose a Type-Balanced Contextual Learning (TBCL) method, featuring a sentence-duplet learning scheme and a contextual consistency loss. This approach offers a fresh perspective for INER through context analysis. Extensive experiments across ten INER settings on three highly recognized datasets showcase the efficacy of our TBCL method, highlighting its proficiency in resolving the biased context issue inherent in pseudo-labeling based INER approaches.
title: Type-Balanced Contextual Learning for Incremental Named Entity Recognition

title_translated: 面向增量命名实体识别的类型平衡上下文学习
summary_translated: 增量命名实体识别（INER）是信息抽取中的关键任务，强调在非结构化文本中逐步识别新的实体类型。面对持续涌入的实体类型，INER面临两个重大挑战：灾难性遗忘的普遍问题以及非实体类型语义的特殊漂移问题。尽管基于伪标签的INER方法在应对这些问题上已证明有效，但此前被忽视的问题——上下文偏差——随之浮现。我们的分析表明，在新句子中，表示旧实体类型的标记的上下文关联相较于其在旧句子中的上下文，对新实体类型表现出更强的偏向性。这种倾向加剧了旧知识的退化，同时促进了新知识的过拟合。为解决这一上下文偏差问题，我们提出了一种类型平衡上下文学习（TBCL）方法，包含句子对学习机制和上下文一致性损失。该方法通过上下文分析为INER提供了新视角。在三个知名数据集上的十个INER设置中进行的大量实验验证了TBCL方法的有效性，凸显其在解决基于伪标签的INER方法固有上下文偏差问题方面的卓越能力。

summary: Neural audio codecs (NACs) convert speech into discrete token sequences, and prior work has reported that these sequences follow language-like statistical laws. This paper analyzes the token statistics of 13 NACs spanning multi-codebook residual vector quantization (RVQ), single-codebook VQ, and non-VQ designs, evaluated on three corpora under clean, white-noise, and real-world DEMAND-noise conditions. Zipf and Heaps parameters, unigram entropy, codebook occupancy, and Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) are estimated from matched token samples with explicit fit-validity safeguards and family-conditional $n$-gram orders. Corpus identity explains little variance in any metric, whereas acoustic condition and quantizer meta-category dominate in a metric-dependent way, and unigram entropy is the metric most strongly associated with meta-category. Clean-to-noise JSD computed at a common unigram order is associated with mel-cepstral distortion most clearly under DEMAND noise. The collapse and explosion degradation signatures previously reported for RVQ codecs concentrate in RVQ cells under white and DEMAND noise, respectively; explosion also occurs in non-VQ codecs, and single-codebook VQ codecs shift in occupancy and distribution shape without either signature. These results provide architecture-conditioned conventions for applying language-statistical analysis to NAC tokens.
title: Language-Statistical Analysis of Neural Audio Codec Tokens Across Architectures, Corpora, and Noise Conditions

title_translated: 跨架构、语料库与噪声条件下神经音频编解码器标记的语言统计分析
summary_translated: 神经音频编解码器（NACs）将语音转换为离散标记序列，先前研究指出这些序列遵循类语言的统计规律。本文分析了13种NACs的标记统计特性，涵盖多码本残差向量量化（RVQ）、单码本VQ及非VQ设计，评估于三个语料库在干净、白噪声和真实世界DEMAND噪声条件下的表现。通过匹配的标记样本并采用显式的拟合有效性保障和家族条件$n$-gram阶数，估计了Zipf与Heaps参数、一元熵、码本占用率以及Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD）。语料库身份在任何指标中解释的方差极小，而声学条件和量化器元类别则以指标依赖方式占据主导地位，其中一元熵与元类别关联最强。在共同一元阶数下计算的干净到噪声JSD在DEMAND噪声下与梅尔倒谱失真关联最明显。此前报道的RVQ编解码器崩溃与爆炸退化特征分别集中于白噪声和DEMAND噪声下的RVQ单元；爆炸现象也出现在非VQ编解码器中，而单码本VQ编解码器虽在占用率和分布形状上发生偏移，但未出现上述两种退化特征。这些结果为在NAC标记上应用语言统计分析提供了基于架构-条件的规范指导。

summary: Codec-based text-to-speech (TTS) models make language-model post-training applicable to speech generation, but it remains unclear when learned perceptual predictors can serve as reinforcement learning rewards without losing alignment with human listeners. We study this question with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using learned rewards for anime-like speaking style, naturalness, likability, and arousal. To prevent perceptual rewards from being optimized through transcript drift, we introduce a character error rate (CER) zone constraint and compare policy optimization with Best-of-$N$ reranking under the same reward gate. Across single-reward runs, each reward primarily improves its own target metric, showing that subjective predictors are not interchangeable quality surrogates. Multi-rater A/B tests further show uneven human transfer, while a reward-gap analysis separates average transfer from within-axis calibration: signed reward gaps significantly predict listener choices in the pooled analysis, whereas residual CER gaps do not, but per-axis calibration remains heterogeneous. Best-of-8 is a strong human-level baseline and is not clearly worse than GRPO perceptually, suggesting that GRPO should be viewed as amortizing reward-selected behavior into the policy rather than uniformly outperforming reranking. These results support analyzing subjective speech rewards as predictor-axis-base tuples and provide practical diagnostics for selecting rewards before multi-reward speech post-training.
title: When Does Predictor-Based RL Align with Human Perception? A Study of Subjective Rewards in Codec-Based Speech Language Models
title_translated: 基于预测器的强化学习何时与人类感知对齐？关于编解码器语音语言模型中主观奖励的研究
summary_translated: 基于编解码器的文本转语音（TTS）模型使语言模型后训练可应用于语音生成，但尚不清楚在何种情况下学习到的感知预测器可作为强化学习奖励而不丧失与人类听者的对齐。我们使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）研究此问题，利用学习到的奖励来优化动漫式说话风格、自然度、喜爱度和唤醒度。为防止感知奖励因转录漂移而被优化，我们引入字符错误率（CER）区域约束，并在相同奖励门控下比较策略优化与Best-of-$N$重排序。在单奖励运行中，每种奖励主要提升其目标指标，表明主观预测器并非可互换的质量代理。多评分者A/B测试进一步显示人类迁移不均衡，而奖励差距分析将平均迁移与轴内校准分离：合并分析中，符号化的奖励差距显著预测听者选择，而残差CER差距则无此效应，但轴内校准仍呈异质性。Best-of-8是一个强大的人类水平基线，其感知表现并不明显劣于GRPO，提示应将GRPO视为将奖励选择行为摊销至策略中，而非统一优于重排序。这些结果支持将主观语音奖励视为基于预测器轴的元组，并为多奖励语音后训练前的奖励选择提供实用诊断工具。

summary: Ambient AI scribes draft clinical notes under the reassurance that a clinician signs every note. We audited three commercial AI scribes on the same 142 consultations: 565 notes from recorded UK primary-care and US ambulatory encounters plus authored scenarios. Twelve discovery passes proposed 13,678 candidate errors; the 5,898 clearing an importance filter went to an adversarial panel of two models from different families, each told to refute what it could, and 618 survived. One note in three (31.3% [27.0, 35.6]) carries a verified failure, concentrated in allergy and medication information, invented patient identity, and history written up as examination on telephone consultations that can contain none. No product was given a patient record; setting aside the two classes a record would have prefilled, invented identity and dates, the rate is 24.8% [20.8, 29.0]. One failure mode did not fit our scheme, drawn from published scribe-error taxonomies: a treatment the clinician retracts, recorded as delivered care. Two clinicians adjudicated blind, disjoint samples: a physician author upheld 20 of 21 findings (95.2% [77.3, 99.2]) and an independent clinician, not an author, 12 of 12 ([75.8, 100]); both judged every sampled refusal genuine. A failure rate depends on the instrument as much as the scribes. With model, evidence and settings fixed, the review instruction alone moves the share of candidates verified from 9.3% to 79.0%, and the reviewing family moves it too: alone at that instruction the gentler flags 54.8% of notes against 27.8%. Between 28% and 97% of sampled notes carry a failure depending on the standard. Published audits disagree among themselves by a margin instrument differences alone can produce: omission is 54-86% of their errors against our 23.1%. We release all 618 findings with transcript-side evidence, every prompt and model version, and the re-runnable pipeline.
title: One note in three: a verified census of three deployed AI scribes, and the instrument that counted it

title_translated: 三份部署AI文书员的核实普查及其计数工具
summary_translated: 环境型AI文书员在医生签署每份笔记的保证下起草临床记录。我们对三款商用AI文书员在同一组142次诊疗中进行了审计：包括565份来自英国初级保健和美国门诊就诊的录音记录及作者编写场景的笔记。经过十二轮发现性排查，提出13,678个候选错误；经重要性筛选后，5,898个进入由不同模型家族的两模型组成的对抗性评审小组，各自尝试反驳可质疑内容，最终618个存活。每三份笔记中有一份（31.3% [27.0, 35.6]）存在经证实的失败，主要集中于过敏史与用药信息、虚构患者身份，以及在电话咨询中将病史误写为检查内容（此类咨询本不应包含检查）。没有产品获得患者记录；若排除记录本应预填的两类（虚构身份与日期），失败率为24.8% [20.8, 29.0]。一种失败模式不符合我们既有的分类体系，源自已发表的文书员错误分类法：医生撤回的治疗被记录为已实施的护理。两名独立临床医生盲评互不重叠的样本：一位作者医师确认21项中的20项（95.2% [77.3, 99.2]），另一位非作者独立医师确认12项中的12项（[75.8, 100]）；两人均判断所有拒绝均为真实。失败率不仅取决于文书员本身，更受评估工具影响。在模型、证据和设置固定的情况下，仅改变评审指令即可使候选验证比例从9.3%跃升至79.0%，且评审模型家族也产生影响：在相同指令下，较温和的模型验证54.8%的笔记，而较激进的模型仅为27.8%。根据标准不同，采样笔记中失败比例在28%至97%之间波动。公开审计结果之间的分歧程度，足以由工具差异单独解释：遗漏错误占其总错误的54%-86%，而我们的数据为23.1%。我们发布全部618项发现及其对应的转录证据、每个提示与模型版本，以及可重复运行的流水线。

summary: Ambient AI scribes draft clinical notes, and published audits find their dominant error is omission: information the encounter established that the note fails to record. The standard check is an LLM judge: a second model reads the note against the transcript and flags problems. We ask whether judges detect omissions. Public corpora cannot supply the answer key: their clinician reference notes and transcripts are materially discrepant. Our benchmark has 500 single-error note pairs from audited fact sheets, 298 with a named fact certainly absent and 202 added-or-altered controls. Across eight judge designs, paired discrimination (the flawed note below its clean twin, 0.5 a coin flip) reads 0.79-0.94 on added or altered content and 0.50-0.63 on omissions. On single notes, no design flags omissions reliably more often than perfect notes. Wording changes, voting and GEPA prompt optimisation move the operating point without creating usable detection. Restructuring the task recovers it: list the facts the transcript establishes, then check the note for each. Two methods reach it independently and trade off: a per-fact pipeline, and a GEPA-evolved prompt doing the same in one call. The pipeline's flags name the missing fact and its severity at 2.7% false alarms. The single call detects more (36.9% against 24.6%, p=0.002) at 6.2% false alarms and a tenth of the cost per note. A physician author validated 70 items and, where the two routes disagree, sided with the pipeline on 10 of 10 (p=0.002). A second clinician, not an author, graded the severity rubric blind and agrees to within a grade. On real vendor notes from a companion census no benchmark threshold transfers, but the re-calibrated single call detects more than the best of the eight at half its false-alarm rate. Omissions whose fact is restated elsewhere defeat both routes. We release the benchmark, prompts and judgements.
title: LLM Judges Verify Presence, Not Absence: Omission Blindness in AI Clinical Notes and What Recovers It

title_translated: LLM裁判验证存在性，而非不存在性：AI临床笔记中的遗漏盲区及其恢复方法
summary_translated: 环境型AI文书员起草临床笔记，已有公开审计发现其主要错误为遗漏：即在会诊中已确立但笔记中未记录的信息。标准核查方式是使用LLM裁判：第二个模型阅读笔记并与转录内容比对，标记问题。我们探究裁判是否能检测遗漏。公共语料库无法提供答案键：其临床参考笔记与转录内容存在实质性差异。我们的基准包含500对单错误笔记，来自审计事实表，其中298对明确缺失某个具体事实，202对为添加或修改的对照组。在八种裁判设计中，成对判别（有缺陷笔记低于其干净副本，0.5相当于抛硬币）在添加或修改内容上的得分范围为0.79–0.94，在遗漏上的得分仅为0.50–0.63。在单个笔记评估中，没有任何设计能比完美笔记更可靠地标记遗漏。措辞变化、投票机制和GEPA提示优化虽能移动操作点，但未能实现可用的检测能力。重构任务可恢复检测能力：先列出转录中确立的事实，再逐一检查笔记。两种方法独立达成目标并形成权衡：一种是逐事实流水线，另一种是GEPA演化出的单次调用提示完成相同任务。流水线方法的标记能指明缺失事实及其严重性，误报率为2.7%。单次调用方法检测更多（36.9% vs 24.6%，p=0.002），误报率为6.2%，成本仅为前者的十分之一。一位医师作者验证了70项，当两种路径意见相左时，10项中全部支持流水线（p=0.002）。第二位非作者临床医生盲评严重性量表，结果与之基本一致。在配套普查的真实厂商笔记上，基准阈值无法直接转移，但重新校准后的单次调用方法在误报率仅为八种设计中最优者一半的前提下，检测能力更强。当缺失事实在其他地方被重述时，两种方法均失效。我们发布该基准、提示及裁判结果。

summary: Computational mental health screening using multimodal speech and text has shown great promise. However, existing models often assume all clinical speech protocols carry equivalent evidentiary validity. In reality, heterogeneous protocols, from free interviews to fixed reading tasks, support fundamentally different evidence. Forcing uniform reasoning flattens these boundaries, causing models to hallucinate symptoms from irrelevant text or overclaim support. Even advanced long chain-of-thought LLMs fail to resolve this issue, as free-form reasoning can exacerbate boundary violations. To address this, we reformulate multimodal screening as an evidence-bounded reasoning problem. We introduce the Evidence Package Benchmark, integrating 1,870 packages across six heterogeneous sources with explicit modality masks and evidence permissions. We further propose EviBound, a protocol-aware evidence control framework. Unlike direct LLM prompting, EviBound uses a profile-aware planner to restrict reasoning scope, orchestrates evidence tools via five-way acoustic consensus, and enforces a boundary critic to suppress unsupported claims. Empirical results show EviBound achieves a held-out test Depression AUROC of 0.8658, exceeding the strongest direct omni-modal baseline by +0.0811 AUROC while maintaining zero claim violations. Our work moves beyond unconstrained accuracy toward evidence-consistent, protocol-aware systems for safer clinical NLP research.
title: Evidence-Bounded Mental Health Reasoning from Heterogeneous Speech Protocols

title_translated: 异构语音协议下的证据约束心理健康推理
summary_translated: 利用多模态语音和文本进行计算心理健康的筛查展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有模型通常假设所有临床语音协议具有同等的证据效力。实际上，从自由访谈到固定阅读任务的异构协议支持的根本上不同的证据。强制统一推理会模糊这些边界，导致模型从无关文本中幻觉出症状或过度声称支持。即使先进的长链思维大语言模型也无法解决这一问题，因为自由形式的推理可能加剧边界违规。为应对这一问题，我们将多模态筛查重新定义为证据约束推理问题。我们引入了证据包基准（Evidence Package Benchmark），整合了来自六个异构来源的1,870个证据包，包含显式的模态掩码和证据权限。我们进一步提出了EviBound——一种协议感知的证据控制框架。不同于直接的大语言模型提示，EviBound使用基于用户画像的规划器限制推理范围，通过五路声学共识协调证据工具，并强制执行边界批评机制以抑制无支持的声明。实证结果表明，EviBound在保留测试集上的抑郁症AUROC达到0.8658，比最强的直接全模态基线高出+0.0811 AUROC，同时保持零声明违规。我们的工作超越了无约束的准确性，迈向更安全的、符合证据一致性和协议感知的临床自然语言处理研究。

summary: Retrieval-augmented generation systems can precompute and store key-value caches of retrieved documents to avoid re-encoding context at every query. Quantizing these caches further reduces storage, but no prior work asks whether compression damages faithfulness, whether responses remain grounded in the retrieved evidence. Faithfulness and accuracy are not equivalent: a model can produce a correct answer that is no longer supported by the context it was given. We evaluate Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct under INT8 and INT4 quantization on RGB and HotpotQA, measuring both accuracy and faithfulness with a hallucination detector, NLI entailment, and an LLM judge. INT8 is near-lossless across both metrics. INT4 reduces accuracy and, more critically, even among answers that remain factually correct, over 90% of faithfulness changes are negative, i.e., accuracy metrics are blind to this regression. The harm grows under noisy retrieval and with more retrieved chunks. Faithfulness must be audited before compressed caches are deployed.
title: Faithfulness Is Not Free: Auditing Offline KV-Cache Quantization in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: Grounding Language Models: Learning Faithfully and Efficiently @ EMNLP 2026
title_translated: 忠实性并非免费：对检索增强生成中离线KV缓存量化效果的审计
summary_translated: 检索增强生成系统可通过预计算并存储检索文档的键值缓存，避免每次查询时重新编码上下文。对这些缓存进行量化可进一步降低存储开销，但此前研究未探讨压缩是否损害忠实性，即生成内容是否仍基于所检索的证据。忠实性与准确性并不等同：模型可能生成正确答案，但该答案已不再由其接收的上下文支持。我们在RGB和HotpotQA数据集上评估Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct在INT8和INT4量化下的表现，使用幻觉检测器、NLI蕴含判断和大语言模型评分器同时测量准确性和忠实性。INT8在两项指标上几乎无损。而INT4不仅降低了准确性，更关键的是，在仍保持事实正确的回答中，超过90%的忠实性变化为负面，即准确性指标对此退化完全视而不见。在噪声检索和更多检索片段的情况下，这种损害进一步加剧。因此，压缩缓存在部署前必须进行忠实性审计。

summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) trains a base language model to imitate target responses, and these targets may require knowledge the base model has not robustly internalized. We study this as a source of hallucinations and frame a group of mitigation methods as \emph{knowledge-aligned SFT}: constraining SFT training targets to the base model's parametric knowledge. Under a unified setup, we compare existing generation-based and estimation-based knowledge-alignment methods and introduce two new variants: Evidence Rewrite, which verifies base-model generations using external evidence, and Recall Rewrite, which retains claims only when they can be consistently recalled by the base model. Experiments with Qwen 3 4B and OLMo 3 7B show that knowledge-aligned SFT can reduce factual hallucinations on WildHalu and Biography while largely preserving general capabilities. Recall Rewrite yields the strongest factuality gains and improves refusal behavior on UnknownBench. It thereby confirms that SFT targets beyond the base model's knowledge drive hallucination behavior.
title: Stick to What You Know: A Study of Knowledge-Aligned Supervised Fine-Tuning
title_translated: 坚持你所知：知识对齐监督微调的研究
summary_translated: 监督微调（SFT）通过训练基础语言模型模仿目标响应，但这些目标可能需要基础模型尚未牢固内化的知识。我们将此视为幻觉的来源，并将一系列缓解方法归类为‘知识对齐SFT’：即约束SFT训练目标仅限于基础模型的参数化知识。在统一设置下，我们比较了现有的基于生成和基于估计的知识对齐方法，并引入两种新变体：Evidence Rewrite，利用外部证据验证基础模型的生成；Recall Rewrite，仅当基础模型能一致回忆起某主张时才保留该主张。在Qwen 3 4B和OLMo 3 7B上的实验表明，知识对齐SFT可在WildHalu和Biography数据集上减少事实性幻觉，同时基本保持通用能力。Recall Rewrite带来了最强的事实性提升，并改善了UnknownBench上的拒绝行为。这证实了超出基础模型知识范围的SFT目标会引发幻觉行为。

summary: We study self-modeling: an LLM's ability to answer questions about its own behavior. We focus on verifiable behavioral questions, such as whether a prompt edit would change the model's final answer. To measure this capability, we introduce a benchmark that tests diverse types of self-modeling questions. Current models show non-trivial but limited self-modeling skill, and make systematic mistakes on simple counterfactual questions about their own behavior. To improve self-modeling skill, we develop a scalable synthetic-data pipeline that produces self-modeling training data, and show that reinforcement-learning can improve aggregate self-modeling skill across three open-source model families with some transfer to held-out tasks. These gains, however, do not seem to constitute introspection consistently: improved self-modeling may not arise from privileged access to the model's internal decision process.
title: Evaluating and Improving LLM Self-Modeling
comment: 89 pages, 25 figures. Published as a conference paper at EMNLP '26 (Main)
title_translated: 评估与改进大语言模型的自我建模能力
summary_translated: 我们研究自我建模：大语言模型对其自身行为进行问答的能力。重点关注可验证的行为问题，例如修改提示是否会改变模型的最终答案。为衡量这一能力，我们引入了一个基准，用于测试多种类型的自我建模问题。当前模型展现出非平凡但有限的自我建模技能，并在关于自身行为的简单反事实问题上出现系统性错误。为提升自我建模能力，我们开发了一种可扩展的合成数据生成管道，用于生产自我建模训练数据，并证明强化学习可提升三个开源模型家族的整体自我建模能力，且部分具备向未见任务迁移的能力。然而，这些提升似乎并未构成一致的内省：自我建模能力的提升未必源于对模型内部决策过程的特权访问。

summary: We present CogEvol, a family of models trained specifically for Learning Environment Generation: turning a course brief into a finished learning artifact (structured-JSON slides or self-contained interactive HTML pages) in a single pass. Across 220k production requests, CogEvol completes a slide in a median of 17 seconds and an interactive page in 59, replacing minutes-long multi-turn agent scaffolding. Reliability is enforced rather than hoped for: a production-grounded data pipeline turns real failures into 53,687 verified SFT samples, and a hybrid rule-plus-VLM reward drives GRPO-based RL, hardened after we caught and fixed a reward-hacking episode that produced visually convincing but unplayable games. CogEvol-27B scores 83.7 on slide quality and 63.7 on a 500-case interactive-HTML benchmark with 26.9x fewer parameters than flagship coding models, and, in collaboration with the OpenMAIC team, serves their live production traffic. CogEvol-4B is released openly under the Apache 2.0 license at https://github.com/CogEvol/CogEvol-4B; external flagships are measured on the same suites under the identical harness. Scaffold editing cuts interactive-page generation cost by a further ~76%, and the full stack runs on domestic Ascend accelerators at application-level parity with A800 GPUs, lowering the unit cost of AI-native education at scale.
title: CogEvol: Towards Efficient and Reliable Learning Environment Generation
title_translated: CogEvol：迈向高效可靠的智能学习环境生成
summary_translated: 我们提出CogEvol，一类专为学习环境生成设计的模型：将课程简报一次性转化为完成的学习成果（结构化JSON幻灯片或自包含的交互式HTML页面）。在22万次生产请求中，CogEvol平均17秒生成一张幻灯片，59秒生成一个交互页面，取代了耗时数分钟的多轮代理搭建流程。可靠性通过生产数据驱动的流水线实现：真实失败案例被转化为53,687个经验证的监督微调样本，结合规则+视觉语言模型的混合奖励机制驱动GRPO强化学习，并在发现并修复一次奖励劫持事件（产生视觉逼真但不可玩的游戏）后进一步加固。CogEvol-27B在幻灯片质量上得分为83.7，在500项交互式HTML基准上得分为63.7，参数量仅为旗舰代码模型的1/26.9，且与OpenMAIC团队合作服务于其实时生产流量。CogEvol-4B已开源，许可证为Apache 2.0，地址为https://github.com/CogEvol/CogEvol-4B；外部旗舰模型在同一套测试环境中进行评估。模板编辑使交互页面生成成本再降低约76%，整个系统可在国产Ascend加速器上运行，性能与A800 GPU相当，显著降低了大规模AI原生教育的单位成本。

summary: LLMs can imitate how people write, which raises concerns about impersonation, trust, and detection in social settings. These concerns are especially important for adolescents, who use generative AI frequently but may struggle to recognize it. We introduce \textit{DoppelBot}, a cooperative social deduction game designed to study how young people detect and respond to AI impersonation. Through studies with middle schoolers, we investigate whether a DoppelBot prompts reflection on privacy and impersonation, how repeated exposure affects AI-detection accuracy as agents become more personalized, and which strategies students use to identify AI doppelgängers. We find that students' detection accuracy improves over time, driven by a shift from relying on linguistic cues to leveraging shared social and contextual signals. Students also demonstrated an understanding of AI limitations such as embodiment and reflected on broader issues such as data privacy. To support future research, we release an anonymized dataset of game transcripts and voting behavior.
title: Detecting AI Impostors: How Do Middle Schoolers Identify LLM Agents in a Live Collaborative Setting?
title_translated: 识别AI冒名者：中学生如何在实时协作环境中识别LLM代理？
summary_translated: 大型语言模型能够模仿人类的写作风格，这引发了社交环境中关于冒名、信任和检测的担忧。这一问题对青少年尤其重要，因为他们频繁使用生成式AI，但可能难以识别其存在。我们提出了DoppelBot，一种合作型社会推理游戏，用于研究年轻人如何检测和应对AI冒名行为。通过针对中学生的实验，我们探讨了DoppelBot是否引发对隐私和冒名的反思，重复暴露如何影响AI检测准确率（随着代理个性化程度提高），以及学生使用的识别策略。研究发现，学生的检测准确率随时间提升，主要源于从依赖语言线索转向利用共享的社会与情境信号。学生还表现出对AI局限性（如具身性）的理解，并反思了数据隐私等更广泛的问题。为支持未来研究，我们发布了匿名化的游戏对话记录和投票行为数据集。

summary: We present a family of retrieval methods for Polish statutory law built on document surrogates: language-model annotations attached to statutory articles at index time. Three designs occupy different points on the cost-quality frontier. ASCR is a surrogate cascade with reranking; ASCR-H fuses a dense list into that cascade; and DTF replaces both language-model stages with three lexical and dense retrievers, weighted reciprocal rank fusion, and a deterministic re-scoring prior, using no model call before generation. We evaluate all three against fourteen lexical, dense, fused and ablated baselines plus four controls, on 300 questions from the 2024 and 2025 Polish bar and legal counsel entrance examinations (264 with their reference article in the corpus), over 82,508 articles from 1,133 acts. On paired McNemar tests, ASCR-H places the reference provision at rank one significantly more often than every other non-oracle configuration except one of its own ablations (eighteen of twenty comparisons significant in its favour at p < 0.005), reaching 72.3% against 61.7% for BM25 and 52.3% for dense retrieval. The advantage is concentrated at the head and does not survive depth: it is significant at cutoffs of one and five, disappears by ten, and by twenty DTF leads on point estimate (86.0% versus 84.5%) at one ninth the latency and less than half the cost. Ablation attributes 27.6 points of rank-one accuracy to the reranking stage alone. We further report that the ranking advantage does not extend to citation accuracy, where DTF matches the oracle ceiling, and three negative results on lemmatisation, pseudo-relevance feedback and query rewriting. Surrogate annotation covers 27.0% of the corpus but every reference provision in the benchmark, an asymmetry we disclose and discuss. Benchmark, per-question outputs and paired significance tests are publicly available.
title: Annotated Surrogate Retrieval for Polish Statutory Law
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Code and data: this https URL
title_translated: 波兰法律条文的标注代理检索方法
summary_translated: 我们提出了一类基于文档代理（在索引时附加到法律条文的语言模型注释）的波兰法律条文检索方法。三种设计分别位于成本-质量权衡的不同位置：ASCR是一种带有重排序的代理级联；ASCR-H将密集列表融合进该级联；DTF则用三个词法和密集检索器替代语言模型阶段，采用加权倒数排名融合及确定性重评分先验，生成前无需调用模型。我们在300个来自2024年和2025年波兰律师与法律顾问入学考试的问题上评估了三种方法，涵盖82,508条来自1,133部法案的条文，对比了14种词法、密集、融合及消融基线以及4个控制组。配对McNemar检验显示，ASCR-H在除自身一个消融版本外的所有非Oracle配置中显著更常将参考条款排在首位（20次比较中有18次在p < 0.005下显著），达到72.3%的首项准确率，优于BM25的61.7%和密集检索的52.3%。优势集中在头部位置，深度增加后不再显著：在截断点为1和5时显著，10处消失，20处时DTF以86.0%对84.5%的点估计领先，且延迟仅为九分之一，成本不足一半。消融分析表明，仅重排序阶段就贡献了27.6个百分点的首项准确率。此外，排名优势未延伸至引用准确性，DTF在此项上达到Oracle上限；同时报告了词干化、伪相关反馈和查询重写三项负面结果。代理注释覆盖了27.0%的语料库，但所有基准中的参考条款均被覆盖，这种不对称性我们已披露并讨论。基准、每题输出及配对显著性测试结果均已公开。

summary: Travel itinerary generation requires balancing strict spatio-temporal constraints with human preferences. Existing LLM-based planners mainly rely on structured attributes and pre- defined traveler personas, but real travel deci- sions are often shaped by reviews that reveal experiential factors such as comfort, safety, ser- vice quality, ambiance, crowding, and hidden risks absent from structured databases. Incor- porating such review information is therefore critical to realistic, user-centric itinerary gen- eration. We propose TRIPPULSE1, a multi- agent framework for review-grounded travel planning. Instead of relying on a monolithic planner (and face context and reasoning bot- tlenecks), TRIPPULSE2 decomposes itinerary generation into specialized agents (each op- erating over localized contexts) for accom- modations, transportation, meals, attractions, and events, coordinated through a global or- chestrator with scheduling mechanisms that enforce temporal and budget feasibility. We augment TRIPCRAFT with 100K+ real-world reviews and introduce Review-Grounded Per- sona Alignment (RGPA), an LLM-as-a-Judge metric for evaluating alignment with human- centric travel experiences. Experiments across multiple trip durations and diverse proprietary and open-source models show that TRIPPULSE maintains strong constraint satisfaction while generating more personalized and experien- tially grounded itineraries.
title: TRIPPULSE: Multi-Agent Travel Planning with Review-Grounded Reasoning
title_translated: TRIPPULSE：基于评论信息的多智能体旅行规划
summary_translated: 旅行行程生成需要在严格的时间空间约束与个人偏好之间取得平衡。现有基于大语言模型的规划器主要依赖结构化属性和预定义的旅行者角色，但真实的旅行决策往往受评论影响，这些评论揭示了舒适度、安全性、服务质量、氛围、拥挤程度以及数据库中缺失的隐性风险等体验因素。因此，整合此类评论信息对于实现真实、以用户为中心的行程生成至关重要。我们提出TRIPPULSE1，一种基于评论的多智能体旅行规划框架。不同于单一规划器（易受上下文和推理瓶颈限制），TRIPPULSE2将行程生成分解为多个专业化智能体（各自在局部上下文中运行），分别负责住宿、交通、餐饮、景点和活动，并由全局协调器通过调度机制确保时间与预算可行性。我们扩充TRIPCRAFT数据集至超过10万条真实世界评论，并引入评论基础的角色对齐（RGPA）指标，作为LLM作为裁判来评估与以人为本旅行体验的一致性。在多种行程时长及多样化的专有和开源模型上的实验表明，TRIPPULSE在保持强约束满足的同时，生成了更具个性化和体验基础的行程。

summary: Dynamic stance classification models how a reply responds to its direct parent message, rather than how a post relates to a fixed topic. Existing work has mainly studied this problem in text-only settings, while social media interactions increasingly rely on images, screenshots, memes, reaction images, and cross-modal references. We introduce MMDS-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for multimodal dynamic stance classification in social media parent-reply interactions. MMDS-Bench contains 3,482 multimodal instances annotated with a seven-label dynamic stance taxonomy, together with an 800-instance diagnostic subset that requires structured reasoning over parent understanding, reply understanding, and stance-relation inference. We further annotate each instance with five challenge factors covering multimodal fusion, parent framing, non-literal expression, interaction reasoning, and label-boundary ambiguity. We evaluate 12 closed-source and open-source multimodal large language models and propose a reference-grounded LLM-judge protocol for assessing reasoning quality. Results show that current MLLMs still struggle with multimodal dynamic stance understanding, especially in cases that require relational inference beyond separate parent and reply comprehension.
title: MMDS-Bench: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models on Dynamic Stance in Social Media Interactions
title_translated: MMDS-Bench：社交媒体互动中动态立场的多模态大语言模型基准测试
summary_translated: 动态立场分类关注回复如何回应其直接父消息，而非帖子与固定主题的关系。现有研究主要聚焦于纯文本场景，而社交媒体互动日益依赖图像、截图、表情包、反应图片及跨模态引用。我们提出MMDS-Bench，一个用于社交媒体父子回复互动中多模态动态立场分类的诊断性基准。MMDS-Bench包含3,482个多模态实例，标注了七类动态立场标签，并附带800个实例的诊断子集，要求对父消息理解、回复理解及立场关系推理进行结构化推理。我们还为每个实例标注了五个挑战因素，涵盖多模态融合、父消息框架、非字面表达、互动推理和标签边界模糊性。我们评估了12个闭源和开源自适应多模态大语言模型，并提出基于参考的LLM裁判协议以评估推理质量。结果表明，当前多模态大语言模型在动态立场理解方面仍面临挑战，尤其是在需要超越单独理解父消息与回复的关联推理任务中表现不佳。

summary: Adapting large language models to user-specific preferences is often constrained by the cost of human annotation, making preference optimisation impractical in low-resource settings where preferences cannot be reliably labelled by LLMs themselves, e.g., due to cultural, subjective, or personalised contexts. In this paper, we investigate how language models encode preference information in their intermediate representations, finding that activations from chosen and rejected responses form distinct clusters across layers, even in pretrained models. Strikingly, this structure is strengthened by alignment on canonical datasets but erased when the target preferences differ from those the model was aligned on, suggesting aligned LLMs are poor judges for non-mainstream populations. Exploiting this structure, we propose training a lightweight linear probe on a few labelled preference pairs ($\leq$500) and using it to annotate large unlabelled datasets (50K+) for downstream preference optimisation. We systematically evaluate this approach across different datasets, preference optimisation methods and model scales and find that our method consistently outperforms direct training given the same annotation budget, and remains competitive against baselines trained on $50-100\times$ more labelled data in the majority of our settings. Code is available at https://github.com/alessioGalatolo/activ-pref-probe.
title: Low-Resource Preference Adaptation of LLMs via Activation-Based Label Propagation
title_translated: 基于激活的标签传播实现低资源场景下的大语言模型偏好适配
summary_translated: 将大语言模型适配至用户特定偏好通常受限于人工标注的成本，在低资源场景下，由于文化、主观或个性化背景，偏好无法由LLM可靠标注。本文研究语言模型如何在其中间表示中编码偏好信息，发现即使在预训练模型中，选择与拒绝响应的激活也形成不同聚类，且在标准数据集对齐后该结构增强，当目标偏好与模型对齐的偏好不一致时则被消除，表明对齐后的LLM对非主流群体是较差的判断者。利用这一结构，我们提出在少量标注偏好对（≤500）上训练轻量级线性探测器，并用其为大规模未标注数据集（5万+）打标，以支持下游偏好优化。我们在不同数据集、偏好优化方法和模型规模下系统评估该方法，发现其在相同标注预算下始终优于直接训练，并在多数设置中与使用50–100倍更多标注数据的基线方法具有竞争力。代码已公开于https://github.com/alessioGalatolo/activ-pref-probe。

summary: Electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation requires knowledge of cardiology, electrophysiology, clinical diagnosis, ECG waveforms, signal acquisition, and instrumentation. Existing language-model benchmarks, however, primarily assess broad medical knowledge or interpretation of individual ECG signals and images rather than the broader contextual knowledge required for ECG interpretation. We developed ECGQuest, a literature-grounded resource for evaluating and fine-tuning ECG-specific language models. A GPT-4o-based pipeline generated questions from 23 ECG references and Computing in Cardiology proceedings from 2003-2025. The final dataset contains 10,904 unique True/False questions paired with their negated forms (21,808 Q&A pairs). We evaluated three commercial and 20 open-source language models on a held-out test set in a zero-shot setting. Five open-source models with 7-14B parameters were fine-tuned using Low-Rank Adaptation, with BERT and BiomedBERT included as supervised encoder baselines. Generalization was assessed on ECG-related subsets of MedMCQA and MedQA converted to binary True/False questions using official answer keys. Zero-shot accuracy on ECGQuest ranged from 49.5% to 74.4%, with GPT-5 performing best. General-purpose models outperformed medically specialized models, several models showed strong True/False bias, and encoder baselines performed near chance. Fine-tuning improved all open-source models by 6.5-14.1%. Fine-tuned DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B reached 76.3% accuracy, while a five-model voting ensemble reached 78.5%. On MedMCQA and MedQA, fine-tuning mainly benefited weaker or class-biased models and did not consistently improve strong base models. ECGQuest provides a reproducible benchmark for contextual ECG knowledge and shows that parameter-efficient fine-tuning can make smaller language models competitive with substantially larger commercial models.
title: ECGQuest: Benchmarking and Fine-Tuning Language Models for Electrocardiography
title_translated: ECGQuest：用于心电图的语言模型基准测试与微调
summary_translated: 心电图（ECG）解读需要掌握心脏病学、电生理学、临床诊断、心电图波形、信号采集和仪器设备等知识。然而，现有的语言模型基准主要评估广泛的医学知识或单一ECG信号和图像的解读，而非ECG解读所需的更广泛上下文知识。我们开发了ECGQuest，一个基于文献的心电图专用语言模型评估与微调资源。基于GPT-4o的管道从23篇ECG相关文献及2003–2025年Computing in Cardiology会议论文中生成问题。最终数据集包含10,904个独特的真假问题及其否定形式（共21,808个问答对）。我们在保留的测试集上以零样本方式评估了三种商业模型和20个开源语言模型。五个参数量为7–14B的开源模型使用低秩适应（LoRA）进行了微调，BERT和BiomedBERT作为监督编码器基线。泛化能力在将MedMCQA和MedQA的ECG相关子集转换为二元真假问题后进行评估，使用官方答案键。零样本准确率在49.5%至74.4%之间，GPT-5表现最佳。通用模型优于医学专用模型，部分模型表现出明显的真假偏差，编码器基线表现接近随机水平。微调使所有开源模型准确率提升6.5–14.1%。微调后的DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B达到76.3%准确率，五模型投票集成达到78.5%。在MedMCQA和MedQA上，微调主要帮助较弱或类别偏倚的模型，未一致提升强基线模型。ECGQuest提供了一个可复现的上下文ECG知识基准，并表明参数高效的微调可使小型语言模型媲美大型商业模型。

summary: While gender and racial biases in language models have been widely studied, anti-LGBTQ biases remain underexplored, particularly beyond English. Existing benchmarks often do not capture cultural and linguistic variation and rely on gender representations. This paper introduces a multilingual German-English benchmark dataset for the evaluation of anti-LGBTQ biases in language models. It combines community-sourced stereotypes from German-speaking queer individuals with a German translation of WinoQueer. The data is used to evaluate eight language models across sizes and architectures and explore mitigation through fine-tuning on community and progressive media content. Results show that language models reproduce anti-queer stereotypes, with variation across identities and models. Differences between the translated and community-based data highlight the importance of cultural adaptation for multilingual bias evaluation. Fine-tuning reduces bias on average, but not consistently across models and identities. Warning: This text contains examples of anti-queer hateful language and stereotypes.
title: Evaluating and Mitigating Anti-LGBTQ Biases in German and Multilingual Language Models
title_translated: 评估与缓解德语及多语言语言模型中的反LGBTQ偏见
summary_translated: 尽管语言模型中的性别和种族偏见已被广泛研究，但反LGBTQ偏见仍鲜有探讨，尤其在英语之外。现有基准往往无法捕捉文化和语言差异，且依赖于性别表征。本文提出一个涵盖德语-英语的多语言基准数据集，用于评估语言模型中的反LGBTQ偏见。该数据集结合了德语社群来源的刻板印象与WinoQueer的德语翻译。利用该数据集评估了八种不同规模和架构的语言模型，并探索通过在社群及进步媒体内容上微调来缓解偏见。结果表明，语言模型会再现反酷儿刻板印象，且在不同身份和模型间存在差异。翻译数据与社群数据之间的差异凸显了多语言偏见评估中文化适配的重要性。微调平均降低了偏见，但并非在所有模型和身份上都一致有效。警告：本文包含反酷儿仇恨语言和刻板印象示例。

summary: LLMs are increasingly used for interpersonal advice and as tools for studying social behavior across languages and cultures. A common shortcut for eliciting language- or culture-related variation is to ask a model to answer as a native speaker. We test whether this native-speaker persona reproduces the outputs obtained when models instead generate advice in the target language and translate the response back into English. Using 600 interpersonal advice questions across 13 languages and eight LLMs, we compare native-language generation followed by translation (NL) with native-speaker persona prompting (NP), measuring linguistic style, behavioral scaffolding, and forced-choice action recommendations. We find that NP and NL are not interchangeable. Compared to NL, NP often increases lexical social cues, including affiliation and positive tone, while reducing qualities such as concreteness and social attunement; NP also provides less actionable scaffolding in open-ended advice. In forced-choice scenarios, NP changes which action the model selects, favoring confrontation over redirection, with effect sizes varying across languages, topics, and models. Our results show that cross-lingual elicitation strategy is a consequential methodological choice that can change both how advice is framed and which actions models recommend.
title: Personas Differ from Native-Language Generation: Language Pathways Shape LLM Interpersonal Advice

title_translated: 人格设定不同于母语生成：语言路径塑造大语言模型的人际建议行为
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于人际建议以及跨语言和文化的社会行为研究。一种常见的方法是要求模型以母语者身份回答，以获取语言或文化差异。我们检验这种母语者人格设定是否能重现模型直接以目标语言生成建议再翻译回英语的效果。使用13种语言的600个跨文化人际建议问题及8个LLM，我们比较了母语生成后翻译（NL）与母语者人格提示（NP）两种方式，测量语言风格、行为支架和强制选择下的行动推荐。结果发现，NP与NL不可互换。相比NL，NP通常增加词汇层面的社会线索（如亲和力和积极语气），同时降低具体性与社会契合度；NP在开放式建议中也提供较少可操作的行为支架。在强制选择场景中，NP改变了模型选择的行动，倾向于对抗而非引导，效应大小随语言、主题和模型而异。结果表明，跨语言激发策略是一个具有实质性影响的方法论选择，可能改变建议的呈现方式以及模型推荐的行动。

summary: Building language technologies and conducting NLP research for low-resource languages---particularly when led by native speakers or involving participatory research practices---are often framed as means of addressing inequality, serving local communities, and, at times, contributing to *decolonisation*. In this paper, we examine recently published NLP and ML papers, focusing on the narratives used to characterise multilinguality, low-resource languages, and underrepresented cultures. We propose a framework for analysing research framings and identify recurring rhetorical patterns that may hinder accountability and constrain equitable knowledge production for---and by---underserved communities. We further assess the evidential basis of assertions regarding community benefit and find that such statements are often weakly supported or left unsubstantiated. Although community ownership and participation are frequently presented as key objectives, our analysis, supported by statistics from the ACL Anthology, suggests that research outputs more often prioritise resource creation and benchmarking---important but distinct goals---over evidence of broader structural change. We conclude by offering practical recommendations to help authors, reviewers, and readers critically assess these assertions and avoid potentially misleading framings.
title: Beyond Good Intentions: When Does the Framing of Multilingual and Low-Resource NLP Research Become a Caricature?
title_translated: 超越良好意图：多语言与低资源NLP研究的表述何时沦为刻板印象？
summary_translated: 为低资源语言构建语言技术并开展NLP研究——尤其是由母语者主导或涉及参与式研究实践时——常被描述为解决不平等、服务本地社区，甚至贡献于“去殖民化”。本文分析近期发表的NLP与机器学习论文，聚焦于描述多语言性、低资源语言和代表性不足文化时所使用的叙事。我们提出一个分析研究表述的框架，识别出可能阻碍问责制并限制受忽视群体自主知识生产的重复修辞模式。我们进一步评估了关于社区受益的主张的证据基础，发现这些说法往往支持薄弱或未经证实。尽管社区所有权和参与常被列为关键目标，但基于ACL Anthology的统计分析表明，研究产出更多优先于资源创建和基准测试——重要但不同的目标——而非体现更广泛结构性变革的证据。最后，我们提出实用建议，帮助作者、审稿人和读者批判性评估这些主张，避免潜在误导性的表述。

summary: Refusals are often treated as face-threatening acts in pragmatics because they can challenge the requester's socially claimed self-image. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trained to refuse unsafe and inappropriate requests, and these refusals may harm users when models fail to manage this interactional cost properly. While existing work has mainly approached LLM non-compliance as a safety-alignment outcome, it does not provide a way to evaluate whether LLMs refuse appropriately across different harmful contexts. To study this question, we propose (to our knowledge) the first taxonomy of LLM refusals that is grounded in pragmatic theory. Applying this taxonomy to responses from 16 modern LLMs across 14 harm categories, we find that although models differ in how they refuse, their refusals are overall explicit and strongly morally evaluative, with interactional repair occurring mainly through offering or providing safer alternatives instead of interpersonal facework. This pattern is especially consequential in sensitive harm contexts, where overuse of negative framing may make users feel shamed or provoked, undermining the purpose of safe non-compliance. We therefore call for alignment evaluation that considers not only whether models refuse harmful requests, but also whether they refuse in ways that are contextually adaptive and socially accountable for the interactional consequences of saying no.
title: You Shouldn't Have Asked: A Pragmatics-Inspired Taxonomy for Evaluating LLM Refusals

title_translated: 你不该问的：一种基于语用学的评估大语言模型拒绝行为的分类体系
summary_translated: 在语用学中，拒绝常被视为威胁面子的行为，因其可能挑战请求者的社会自我形象。大语言模型（LLMs）日益被训练以拒绝不安全或不当请求，若模型未能妥善管理这种互动成本，可能对用户造成伤害。现有研究主要将LLM的不合规视为安全对齐的结果，但缺乏评估模型在不同有害情境下是否恰当拒绝的方法。为此，我们提出了（据我们所知）首个基于语用理论的LLM拒绝行为分类体系。将该分类体系应用于16个现代LLM在14类危害情境中的响应，发现虽然各模型拒绝方式不同，但总体上拒绝表达明确且具有强烈道德评判色彩，互动修复主要通过提供或给出更安全替代方案实现，而非人际面子维护。这一模式在敏感危害情境中尤为关键，因负面框架的过度使用可能使用户感到羞辱或激怒，从而削弱安全不合规的初衷。因此，我们呼吁对齐评估不仅关注模型是否拒绝有害请求，还应关注其拒绝方式是否具备情境适应性和对说‘不’的互动后果的社会责任。

summary: While automatic speech recognition (ASR) models have achieved remarkable improvements in recent years, performance disparities persist across different speaker populations. One such disparity is for speakers whose first languages (L1) are from families distant from English. This paper investigates the relationship between first language background and English ASR performance. Through empirical analysis, we observe that the correlation between speakers' L1 distance and ASR error rates yields a systematic effect on English Speech, with its strength varying across datasets and models. This association is statistically significant in a follow-up analysis accounting for dataset-level variation in Tweedie mixed-effects models ($p<0.001$ across evaluated models). In addition, analysis of the latent space reveals a L1-based spatial segregation across deeper acoustic layers in the majority of evaluated architectures
title: Linguistic Distance Segregates Latent Representations in Automatic Speech Recognition Systems
title_translated: 语言距离分离自动语音识别系统中的潜在表示
summary_translated: 尽管近年来自动语音识别（ASR）模型取得了显著进步，但在不同说话人群体之间仍存在性能差异。其中一种差异体现在第一语言（L1）与英语语系相距较远的说话者身上。本文研究了第一语言背景与英语ASR性能之间的关系。通过实证分析，我们发现说话者的L1距离与ASR错误率之间的相关性在英语语音上呈现出系统性影响，其强度随数据集和模型的不同而变化。在考虑数据集层面变异的Tweedie混合效应模型后续分析中，该关联具有统计显著性（所有评估模型的p<0.001）。此外，对潜在空间的分析揭示，在大多数评估架构的深层声学层中，存在基于L1的空间分离现象。

summary: Humans play a vital role at every stage of AI development, from data collection and curation to model development and evaluation. However, humans often disagree with each other and sometimes with themselves over time. It is essential to take disagreement into account when building human-centered AI systems, especially in domains where it is prevalent, such as AI safety, content moderation, or sentiment analysis. Disagreement often arises from subjective human opinion and can vary with one's identity, beliefs, and social environment. Despite this, current LLM evaluation approaches frequently rely on aggregating labels (often via plurality voting) to represent consensus, thereby obscuring minority perspectives. By failing to account for human disagreement, these evaluation methods contribute to the reproducibility crisis in AI. Human feedback is also crucial for ensuring that AI systems align with human values. For these systems to be trustworthy, it is critical to ensure that they reflect diverse human values and perspectives. In this thesis proposal, we present a human-centered and perspective-aware framework for reproducible ML evaluation and AI alignment.
title: Thesis Proposal: Toward a Human-Centered and Perspective-Aware Framework for Reproducible ML Evaluation and AI Alignment
