title_translated: SemPOI-RL：对齐LLM语义推理以实现可解释的异地POI序列生成
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）具备强大的语义推理和开放式生成能力，但将其与结构化序列生成对齐仍具挑战性。这一挑战在异地（OOT）POI序列生成中尤为明显，模型需从用户家乡行为中推断可迁移的旅行意图，适应跨城市兴趣漂移，并在结构约束下生成连贯的目的地轨迹。现有方法或依赖隐式ID转移（可解释性差），或直接使用LLM进行序列生成而未显式将推断语义融入位置感知预测。为填补这一空白，我们提出SemPOI-RL框架，将LLM语义推理与结构化序列生成对齐，实现可解释的异地推荐。具体而言，我们首先微调LLM，从用户家乡轨迹中推断目的地导向的旅行风格，使用自然语言作为可解释的语义中间表示。随后引入语义POI对齐模块（SPAM），将这些推断风格嵌入风格条件的掩码自编码器中，实现位置感知的轨迹生成。最后，应用面向推荐的强化学习奖励，对齐LLM生成的风格与下游序列质量。在两个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，SemPOI-RL持续优于传统推荐器和直接LLM基线，同时在旅行各阶段提供可解释的风格归因。代码已公开于https://github.com/Wind-Flipped/SemPOI-RL。

summary: In pointwise document reranking, Chain-of-Thought models typically underperform direct scoring models. While existing diagnostics attribute this to inferior classification, score polarization, or calibration breakdown, whether targeted training can bridge this gap remains unclear. Our empirical study first confirms that this gap is stable across scales up to 32B parameters, ruling out model and data capacity confounders. We then apply stress tests utilizing reinforcement learning, fine-grained supervision, and architectural decoupling to explicitly repair these deviations. Although these interventions improve classification accuracy and absolute scores, the relative ranking gap persists. These findings suggest that, within the pointwise scoring paradigm, routing continuous relevance semantics through discrete text constrains ranking signal resolution, revealing a bottleneck that is stable and difficult to overcome under current standard methods, rather than an easily resolvable training bias.
title: Beyond Polarization: The Generative Constraint of Chain-of-Thought in Pointwise Reranking
title_translated: 超越极化：思维链在逐项重排序中的生成约束
summary_translated: 在逐项文档重排序中，思维链（Chain-of-Thought）模型通常表现不如直接评分模型。尽管现有诊断认为其性能较差源于分类能力弱、得分极化或校准失效，但针对性训练能否弥合这一差距尚不明确。我们的实证研究首先确认该差距在高达32B参数规模下依然稳定，排除了模型与数据容量混淆因素的影响。随后，我们采用压力测试手段，包括强化学习、细粒度监督和架构解耦，以显式修复这些偏差。尽管这些干预提升了分类准确率和绝对得分，相对排序差距依然存在。这些发现表明，在逐项评分范式中，将连续相关性语义通过离散文本传递会限制排序信号的分辨率，揭示了一个在当前标准方法下稳定且难以克服的瓶颈，而非易于解决的训练偏差。

summary: Natural-language critiques provide supervision beyond scalar rewards for non-verifiable generation, which lacks deterministic verifiers. In critique-guided refinement, a critic gives feedback on an initial response and an actor revises it. However, final revision quality does not reveal whether the critique was actually useful: a capable actor may improve without following the feedback, while valid feedback may fail if the actor cannot execute it. We frame critique as actor-conditioned revision guidance, where usefulness depends on whether the feedback helps the target actor address the intended weakness. We introduce TAIScore (Targeted Actionable Improvement Score), a reward that evaluates the instruction, initial response, critique, and revision together, assessing whether the critique targets a real weakness, whether the actor follows it, and whether the intended aspect improves. We use this reward to train an actor-tailored critic with GRPO, and use critique-guided refinements to construct DPO preference pairs for the actor, forming a co-evolving critic-actor loop where the critic adapts to the actor's changing capability. Experiments show that an 8B critic trained with TAIScore outperforms both a zero-shot 120B critic and critics trained with outcome-only or critique-only reward signals. Co-evolving the critic and actor further improves performance, suggesting that effective critique supervision should adapt as the actor changes.
title: Co-Evolving Actor-Conditioned Critics for Non-Verifiable Generation
title_translated: 协同进化动作条件批评者以应对不可验证生成
summary_translated: 自然语言批评为不可验证生成提供了超越标量奖励的监督，这类生成缺乏确定性验证器。在批评引导的优化中，批评者对初始响应给出反馈，动作模型据此修订。然而，最终修订质量无法反映批评是否真正有用：能力强的动作模型可能无需遵循反馈即可改进，而有效的反馈也可能因动作模型无法执行而失败。我们将批评视为动作条件的修订指导，其有效性取决于反馈是否帮助目标动作模型解决预期弱点。我们引入TAIScore（目标可行动改进评分），一种综合评估指令、初始响应、批评和修订的奖励机制，判断批评是否针对真实弱点、动作模型是否采纳反馈，以及预期方面是否得到改善。我们使用该奖励训练面向特定动作模型的批评者（GRPO），并利用批评引导的修订构建DPO偏好对用于动作模型训练，形成批评者-动作模型协同进化的闭环，使批评者随动作模型能力变化而自适应调整。实验表明，使用TAIScore训练的8B批评者优于零样本120B批评者，也优于仅基于结果或仅基于批评的奖励信号训练的批评者。协同进化批评者与动作模型进一步提升了性能，表明有效的批评监督应随动作模型的变化而动态适应。

summary: As pretraining scaling laws approach saturation, Test-Time Scaling (TTS) has emerged as an important direction for improving reasoning by allocating inference-time compute to a fixed model prior. Viewed at a high level, TTS reframes inference as search over a space of partial reasoning states. While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) exposes intermediate steps, common instantiations rely on single-trajectory decoding, limiting recovery from early errors and exploration. This survey systematizes recent progress in tree-search-based reasoning, viewing inference as instance-specific optimization rather than decoding. We trace the evolution from uninformed search to Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), highlighting how sampling-based control supports principled exploration-exploitation trade-offs. To unify a fragmented literature, we introduce a Unified Design Space spanning search topology, evaluation signals, and control dynamics, and advocate a standardized compute-reporting abstraction to make compute-accuracy trade-offs explicit and comparable.
title: When LLM Meets Tree Search: A Systematic View of Inference as Search in Large Language Models
title_translated: 当大语言模型遇见树搜索：大语言模型推理作为搜索的系统性视角
summary_translated: 随着预训练扩展定律接近饱和，测试时扩展（TTS）已成为通过在推理阶段为固定模型分配计算资源来提升推理能力的重要方向。从高层次看，TTS将推理重新定义为对部分推理状态空间的搜索。尽管思维链（CoT）暴露了中间步骤，但常见的实现依赖于单轨迹解码，限制了对早期错误的恢复能力和探索范围。本综述系统化地梳理了基于树搜索的推理最新进展，将推理视为实例特定的优化而非解码过程。我们追溯了从无信息搜索到蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的演进，强调基于采样的控制如何支持合理的探索-利用权衡。为统一碎片化的文献，我们提出了一个涵盖搜索拓扑、评估信号和控制动态的统一设计空间，并倡导采用标准化的计算报告抽象，使计算与准确率之间的权衡更加明确且可比较。

summary: Biomedical artificial intelligence (AI) systems increasingly extract, organize, and reuse scientific claims from literature, clinical trials, and regulatory documents. But automatic extraction alone does not make a claim reliable evidence: a claim becomes useful only when it can be traced to its source, linked to the quantitative details that support it, and read within its biomedical context and uncertainty. This matters as large language models (LLMs) and increasingly autonomous systems drive evidence synthesis, knowledge graph (KG) construction, and decision support. Many text-mining and LLM pipelines remain relation-centric: they capture entities and relations such as Drug--TREATS--Disease, but drop the dose, effect size, population, comparator, uncertainty, and conditions under which a claim holds. Such relations can look actionable yet remain hard to verify, compare, or reuse. In this perspective, we argue for a shift toward quantitative evidence mining---extracting values, units, measured entities and properties, context, uncertainty, provenance, and plausibility as structured evidence units that populate evidence-aware KGs and can be checked for source grounding, unit consistency, completeness, and biological plausibility. We outline a framework for plausibility-aware AI that treats extracted claims not as final answers but as auditable evidence objects, making clear what was measured, how much it changed, in which setting, with what uncertainty, and from which source. The central risk is not only incorrect extraction, but claims that look like evidence while lacking the structure needed to trust them.
title: Quantitative Evidence Mining for Plausibility-Aware Biomedical AI
title_translated: 可信赖性感知的生物医学人工智能中的定量证据挖掘
summary_translated: 生物医学人工智能系统越来越多地从文献、临床试验和监管文件中提取、组织并重用科学主张。但仅靠自动提取并不能使主张成为可靠证据：只有当主张能够追溯其来源、关联支持它的定量细节，并置于生物医学背景和不确定性中时，才具有实际价值。这一点尤为重要，因为大语言模型（LLMs）及日益自主的系统正推动证据综合、知识图谱（KG）构建和决策支持的发展。许多文本挖掘和LLM流程仍以关系为中心：它们捕捉药物—治疗—疾病等实体关系，却忽略了剂量、效应大小、人群、对照组、不确定性以及主张成立的条件。这些关系看似可操作，但实际上难以验证、比较或重用。本文主张转向定量证据挖掘——即提取数值、单位、测量实体与属性、上下文、不确定性、来源和可信度，形成结构化的证据单元，用于构建可信赖的知识图谱，并可检查其来源依据、单位一致性、完整性及生物学合理性。我们提出一种可信赖性感知的人工智能框架，将提取的主张视为可审计的证据对象，明确说明了测量内容、变化程度、应用场景、不确定性水平及来源。核心风险不仅在于错误提取，更在于那些看似证据却缺乏可信结构的主张。

summary: Understanding agent behavior requires methods that scale to thousands of trajectories and surface new patterns in long, often unfamiliar tasks where pre-built classifiers fall short. We propose to bring grounded theory into agent trajectory analysis: a six-decade-old qualitative method from the social sciences, with a principled saturation criterion and an auditable trail from data to theory. We propose AutoTraceGT (Automated Trace analysis through Grounded Theory), the first multi-agent pipeline that automates grounded theory on agent trajectories. It iteratively performs open, axial, and theoretical coding until saturation, producing a behavioral taxonomy tailored to each task. Across six trajectory corpora, AutoTraceGT produces codebooks that recover 73-91 percent of the failure modes in human-annotated taxonomies and surface additional patterns that those taxonomies miss. The emergent theoretical narrative aligns with prior expert accounts. Used as a deductive feature space, the codebook outperforms zero-shot and few-shot LLM baselines on downstream failure prediction. These results suggest Grounded Theory offers a scalable analytic tool for ML researchers and agent developers studying what agents actually do.
title: Using Grounded Theory for Agent Behavior Analysis at Scale
comment: 33 pages. Accepted to the Findings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
title_translated: 基于扎根理论的大规模智能体行为分析
summary_translated: 理解智能体行为需要能够扩展至数千条轨迹的方法，并在长期、通常不熟悉的任务中揭示新模式，而预先构建的分类器在此类场景下往往力不从心。我们提出将扎根理论引入智能体轨迹分析：这一源自社会科学的六十年历史的定性方法，具备严谨的饱和标准和从数据到理论的可审计路径。我们提出AutoTraceGT（通过扎根理论进行自动化轨迹分析），这是首个能够自动化处理多智能体轨迹的扎根理论流水线。它迭代执行开放式编码、轴心编码和理论编码直至饱和，生成针对每个任务定制的行为分类体系。在六个轨迹语料库上，AutoTraceGT生成的代码本恢复了人类标注分类体系中73%-91%的失败模式，并揭示了原分类体系所遗漏的新模式。生成的理论叙事与先前专家描述高度一致。作为演绎特征空间使用时，该代码本在下游失败预测任务中优于零样本和少样本LLM基线。这些结果表明，扎根理论为机器学习研究人员和智能体开发者研究智能体实际行为提供了一种可扩展的分析工具。

summary: Recurrent, attention-free sequence models share a structural weakness: a fading state cannot perform exact recall of something seen once, far in the past. We add to the Kathleen trunk a second memory layer -- a "notebook": a fixed-key holographic (HRR) associative store with a learned local write gate, a self-gating raw read, and write-triggered forgetting -- 25K parameters that attach to the logits of any trunk. (1) Mechanism: on a controlled needle-in-haystack task the notebook reaches 80-82% one-shot recall at 4x the training length, where the bare trunk scores ~4% and a parameter-matched attention head scores 100% inside its training length and 0% beyond it. Addressing is length-invariant by construction; the untrained memory alone recalls at 90% accuracy identically at 512, 2048 and 4096 bytes. Because the store is a linear superposition, two capabilities follow from arithmetic alone: selective unlearning (one subtraction erases one fact to chance, retained facts unharmed) and per-token attribution (counterfactual erasure names the source fact of every correct byte, 100% provenance). (2) Real text: on WikiText-2 bytes the notebook improves prediction of repeated rare words by +0.15-0.27 bits/byte, the gain growing with the distance between mentions and holding zero-shot at 4x training length; write-triggered forgetting eliminates memory pollution at 8x length (first-mention cost +0.33 -> -0.004). (3) Scope and scale: a parameter-matched attention head does generalize on natural-text repetition, so the notebook's claim is exact recall at O(L); on a WikiText-103 ladder (8 to 512 MB) the zero-shot repeat gain rises monotonically. All experiments are pre-registered, seeds reported, and reproducible on a single free-tier GPU.
title: Kathleen Remembers: Length-Invariant One-Shot Recall Without Attention
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures. Paper 4 of the Kathleen series. Mechanism covered by U.S. Provisional Patent Application No. 64/140,260
title_translated: 凯瑟琳记得：无需注意力机制的长度不变一次性回忆
summary_translated: 循环且无注意力的序列模型存在一个结构性弱点：状态衰减无法对过去一次看到的内容进行精确回忆。我们在凯瑟琳主干中增加第二层记忆——‘笔记本’：一个固定键的全息表示（HRR）关联存储，包含学习得到的局部写入门控、自门控原始读取以及写入触发遗忘机制，仅25K参数，可附加到任意主干的logits上。（1）机制：在受控的‘针堆找针’任务中，笔记本在4倍训练长度下达到80%-82%的一次性回忆成功率，而原始主干仅约4%，参数匹配的注意力头在训练长度内可达100%但在超出后降为0%。地址访问在构造上与长度无关；未训练的记忆本身在512、2048和4096字节下均能以90%准确率完成回忆。由于存储是线性叠加，仅通过算术运算即可实现两个能力：选择性遗忘（一次减法即可抹除一条事实至随机水平，保留其他事实）和逐标记归因（反事实擦除可识别每个正确字节的来源事实，100%溯源）。（2）真实文本：在WikiText-2字节上，笔记本提升了重复罕见词的预测性能，增益达+0.15-0.27比特/字节，且增益随提及间隔增大而增长，在4倍训练长度下仍保持零样本性能；写入触发遗忘在8倍长度下消除了记忆污染（首次提及成本由+0.33降至-0.004）。（3）范围与规模：参数匹配的注意力头在自然文本重复任务上也表现出泛化能力，因此笔记本的主张是O(L)级别的精确回忆。在WikiText-103阶梯（8MB至512MB）上，零样本重复增益单调上升。所有实验均预先注册，种子已报告，可在单一免费级GPU上复现。

summary: Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) has been widely adopted to improve LLM-based evaluation by prompting multiple agents to negotiate and reach a consensus. However, for subjective rubric-based scoring, inter-agent agreement does not guarantee alignment with human judgments. In this paper, we compare a single-judge baseline against a consensus-based MAD protocol on subjective evaluation tasks and design three ablations to isolate the impact of role prompting, multi-round interaction, and explicit score sharing. Evaluations across six LLMs show that the single-judge baseline achieves the strongest human alignment on average across six judge models, whereas MAD shows degradation in human alignment on both tasks. Our ablations demonstrate that this performance drop stems primarily from asymmetric role prompting rather than the interaction itself. Specifically, assigning a strict judge role introduces a systematic downward bias that the consensus process fails to correct. The central finding is that this bias reflects strict-stance dominance beyond averaging: the consensus score falls well beyond the arithmetic midpoint of the standalone strict and lenient conditions, rather than averaging them out. Removing role asymmetry (Symmetric MAD) largely recovers baseline performance, while masking peer scores widens inter-agent disagreement on average and worsens average human alignment. These findings demonstrate that multi-agent consensus can enforce artificial agreement at the expense of true human alignment, revealing a structural limitation in consensus-style, role-specialized MAD protocols for subjective scoring.
title: Beyond Consensus: Downward Bias and Role Asymmetry in Multi-Agent LLM Judges for Subjective Evaluation
title_translated: 超越共识：多智能体LLM裁判在主观评价中的向下偏差与角色不对称
summary_translated: 多智能体辩论（MAD）已被广泛采用以通过多个智能体协商并达成共识来改进基于大语言模型的评估。然而，对于基于主观评分标准的打分，智能体间的一致性并不保证与人类判断对齐。本文比较了单裁判基线与基于共识的MAD协议在主观评价任务上的表现，并设计了三种消融实验以分离角色提示、多轮交互和显式分数共享的影响。在六种LLM上的评估显示，单裁判基线在六种裁判模型上的平均人类对齐度最强，而MAD在两项任务上均表现出人类对齐度下降。我们的消融实验表明，性能下降主要源于角色提示的不对称性，而非交互本身。具体而言，赋予严格裁判角色会引入系统性向下偏差，而共识过程无法纠正这一偏差。核心发现是，这种偏差反映了严格立场的主导作用，而非简单平均：共识得分远低于独立严格与宽松条件的算术中点，而非将其平均化。消除角色不对称性（对称MAD）可基本恢复基线性能，而隐藏同伴分数则平均加剧了智能体间的分歧并恶化了平均人类对齐度。这些发现表明，多智能体共识可能以牺牲真实人类对齐为代价强制人为一致，揭示了在主观评分中基于角色专精的共识型MAD协议的结构性局限。

summary: As Large Language Models rapidly advance, performance on standard multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) benchmarks is reaching saturation. While the community has responded by developing increasingly difficult datasets, validating question quality and filtering flawed items remains a labor-intensive process. To provide a scalable diagnostic approach, we propose a two-component probabilistic framework for auditing MCQA benchmarks using model output distributions. First, for benchmark-level analysis, we characterize the probability landscape using the top prediction probability ($P_{top1}$) and normalized residual entropy ($H_{norm}$), summarized globally by Mean Pairwise Distance (MPD). Second, for item-level diagnostics, we introduce noise injection to reduce meaningful distractor competition, enabling us to flag candidate items for targeted human review and categorize residual failure patterns. Across four MCQA benchmarks, our landscape analysis reveals benchmark-level differences in model confidence and residual option competition. Concurrently, our noise-injection method flags potentially actionable item-level issues, showing alignment with expert error annotations from MMLU-Redux. These results suggest that our probability-based framework provides a lightweight audit lens for comparing macro-level benchmark structure and prioritizing individual items for targeted human review.
title: Auditing MCQA Benchmarks through Probability Landscapes
title_translated: 通过概率景观审计多选题基准测试
summary_translated: 随着大语言模型的快速发展，标准多选题问答（MCQA）基准测试上的性能已接近饱和。尽管社区已开发出越来越困难的数据集，但验证问题质量和筛选有缺陷的题目仍是一个劳动密集型过程。为提供可扩展的诊断方法，我们提出一种基于模型输出分布的两组件概率框架，用于审计MCQA基准测试。首先，在基准层面分析中，我们使用最高预测概率（P_top1）和归一化残差熵（H_norm）刻画概率景观，并通过平均成对距离（MPD）进行全局总结。其次，在题目层面诊断中，我们引入噪声注入以降低有意义干扰项的竞争，从而识别出需要针对性人工审查的候选题目，并对残余失败模式进行分类。在四个MCQA基准上，我们的景观分析揭示了模型置信度和残余选项竞争的基准级差异。同时，我们的噪声注入方法成功标记出可能具有行动价值的题目级问题，与MMLU-Redux专家错误标注结果高度一致。这些结果表明，我们的基于概率的框架为比较宏观基准结构和优先处理个别题目进行针对性人工审查提供了轻量级审计视角。

summary: Fine-tuning can improve legal question-answering accuracy without improving how models use law supplied in context. We study this distinction in bilingual Bangladeshi legal QA, where observed errors can arise from answer scoring, retrieval, or failure to use relevant law. We construct a hierarchy-preserving statutory corpus, 2,165 reviewed bilingual fine-tuning examples, and a 150-item supplied-law control. We evaluate six instruction-tuned models: Llama-3.2-1B, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen3.5-0.8B, Qwen3.5-2B, Qwen3.5-4B, and Gemma-4-E2B, with three LoRA seeds per model. To separate effects, we combine constrained option-letter scoring, cyclic option rotation, and controlled removal of the governing provision. On 398 Bar Council outputs, an exact-line parser attributes an accuracy gain of 50.0\% to the Qwen3.5-2B seed-42 adapter, whereas option scoring yields only $3.0\%$. For Gemma-4-E2B, the two scoring methods favor different systems. When the governing provision is guaranteed to be present, five of six reference models improve by $14.7\%-19.3\%$ under the four-order criterion. Removing that provision reduces accuracy by $8.0\%-15.3\%$ for models and by $13.8\%-14.9\%$ points for their adapters. However, difference-in differences estimates show no increase in reliance on the governing provision after fine-tuning. Results show that legal adaptation claims require separating scorer, retriever, and model effects. Our Code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/bangladesh-legal-qa-11E3
title: Do Small Models Use the Law You Give Them? Measuring Context Use on a Bilingual Bangladesh Legal Benchmark
title_translated: 小型模型是否使用了你提供的法律？在双语孟加拉国法律基准上的上下文使用测量
summary_translated: 微调可以提高法律问答的准确性，但并未改善模型对上下文中提供的法律内容的使用能力。我们在双语孟加拉国法律问答任务中研究这一区别，其中观察到的错误可能源于答案评分、检索或未能使用相关法律。我们构建了一个保持层级结构的法规语料库，2,165个经过审核的双语微调示例，以及一个包含150个题目的法律供应控制集。我们评估了六种指令微调模型：Llama-3.2-1B、Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen3.5-0.8B、Qwen3.5-2B、Qwen3.5-4B 和 Gemma-4-E2B，每种模型使用三个LoRA种子。为分离影响因素，我们结合了约束选项字母评分、循环选项轮换和受控移除管辖条款的方法。在398个律师委员会输出中，精确行解析显示，Qwen3.5-2B种子42适配器带来了50.0%的准确率提升，而选项评分仅带来3.0%的提升。对于Gemma-4-E2B，两种评分方法偏好不同的系统。当确保管辖条款存在时，六个参考模型中有五个在四阶标准下准确率提升了14.7%-19.3%。移除该条款后，模型准确率下降8.0%-15.3%，其适配器下降13.8%-14.9个百分点。然而，双重差分估计显示，微调后模型对管辖条款的依赖性并未增加。结果表明，法律适应性声明需要区分评分者、检索器和模型的影响。代码与数据可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/bangladesh-legal-qa-11E3 获取。

summary: Natural-language instructions enable flexible control of synthesized speech, yet emotional TTS systems primarily model a single utterance-level affect, leaving multi-emotion control underexplored. We study two complementary multi-emotion TTS tasks: emotion trajectory, which spans several ordered affective stages, and emotion blending, in which multiple emotions coexist throughout an utterance. These tasks expose a supervision mismatch: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) does not explicitly evaluate emotion features, while single-emotion rewards provide neither structure-aware feedback for trajectory completion nor pair-aware feedback for blending. We introduce HybridEmo, a post-training framework that initializes both tasks with SFT and then aligns the speech-token policy through Group Relative Policy Optimization using a sample-aware hybrid reward. For trajectory samples, segment-aligned consistency combines average and weakest-stage evidence to preserve the correctness and completeness of prescribed stages. For blending samples, a GMM-based reward combines frame-level support from the union of target-emotion anchors in an offline emotion space with an utterance-level weaker-target margin. Both branches share an ASR reward and are routed within a unified policy. On MultiEmo-Test, HybridEmo significantly improves trajectory correctness and blending intensity, without a noticeable degradation in speaker similarity. Human evaluation prefers HybridEmo to CosyVoice 3 and EmoVoice-0.5B, with nearly balanced preferences against Qwen3-TTS.
title: Sequential Trajectories and Simultaneous Blending: Multi-Emotion Modeling for Instruction-Following TTS

title_translated: 序列轨迹与同步融合：面向指令遵循语音合成的多情绪建模
summary_translated: 自然语言指令能够灵活控制合成语音，但现有情绪语音合成系统主要建模单个话语级别的情感，导致多情绪控制研究不足。我们研究了两个互补的多情绪语音合成任务：情绪轨迹，即跨越多个有序情感阶段；以及情绪融合，即多个情绪在整个话语中同时存在。这些任务暴露了监督信号不匹配的问题：监督微调（SFT）未显式评估情绪特征，而单情绪奖励既无法提供轨迹完成所需的结构感知反馈，也无法提供融合任务中的成对感知反馈。我们提出HybridEmo，一种后训练框架，先用SFT初始化两项任务，再通过样本感知的混合奖励，采用组相对策略优化对语音token策略进行对齐。对于轨迹样本，段落对齐一致性结合平均值和最弱阶段证据，以保持预定阶段的正确性和完整性。对于融合样本，基于高斯混合模型（GMM）的奖励结合离线情绪空间中目标情绪锚点的并集在帧级别提供的支持，以及话语级别的较弱目标边际。两个分支共享一个ASR奖励，并在统一策略内路由。在MultiEmo-Test上，HybridEmo显著提升了轨迹正确性和融合强度，且说话人相似性无明显下降。人工评估显示，HybridEmo优于CosyVoice 3和EmoVoice-0.5B，与Qwen3-TTS相比偏好几乎均衡。

summary: We describe the architecture and ablations of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 125B parameters, 6B activated per token, and additional 51B parameters of n-gram embedding tables held off the accelerator. On fourteen pre-training benchmarks the model leads the 397B-A17B predecessor on eight and trails it on the rest by at most 2.6 points, at 1/3 the activated parameters, 1/3 the training tokens, and roughly 1/9 the training FLOPs. Token mixing uses a layer-wise hybrid of Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and global attention, with one full-attention layer in every four; at continued-pretraining time those full-attention layers are replaced by Qwen Sparse Attention (QSA), which scores context at micro-block granularity with a compressed lightweight indexer. The residual stream is widened to four branches and read through an elementwise gate, a design we call the Gated Residual (GR). Capacity is added outside the backbone by a single n-gram embedding layer whose tables are prefetched from host memory. We evaluate every candidate change along three axes: loss together with downstream benchmarks; the cost of the change in training, prefill and decode; and its effect on the optimal hyperparameters and training stability. Loss and downstream accuracy do not always move together: enlarging the n-gram vocabulary lowers loss monotonically while downstream accuracy saturates. The architecture and the Muon optimizer together shift the optimal learning rate and batch size upwards, render batch-size warmup unnecessary, and substantially improve stability under stress tests. Loss, benchmarks, efficiency and stability form one design problem. Solved jointly, they yield a recipe that is simultaneously more efficient, more capable and more stable.
title: On the Design of Qwen3.8-Next Architecture: Evaluation, Efficiency, and Training Stability
title_translated: 关于Qwen3.8-Next架构设计：评估、效率与训练稳定性
summary_translated: 我们描述了Qwen3.8-Flash-Next的架构及其消融实验，这是一个拥有1250亿参数的稀疏专家混合模型，每token激活60亿参数，额外510亿参数的n-gram嵌入表存储在加速器外。在十四项预训练基准测试中，该模型在八项上超越了前代397B-A17B模型，其余项目最多落后2.6分，但仅需三分之一的激活参数、三分之一的训练token，以及约九分之一的训练浮点运算量。令牌混合采用逐层结合门控DeltaNet（GDN）与全局注意力的混合方式，每四层中有一层全注意力；在持续预训练阶段，这些全注意力层被Qwen稀疏注意力（QSA）替代，后者以微块粒度对上下文进行评分，并使用压缩轻量索引器。残差流扩展为四条分支，并通过元素门读取，我们称此设计为门控残差（GR）。容量通过单一n-gram嵌入层添加于主干之外，其表从主机内存预取。我们从三个维度评估每个候选改动：损失及下游基准表现；改动带来的训练、预填充和解码成本；以及对最优超参数和训练稳定性的影响。损失与下游准确率并不总是一致：扩大n-gram词汇量单调降低损失，但下游准确率趋于饱和。架构与Muon优化器共同将最优学习率和批量大小向上调整，使批量预热不再必要，并在压力测试中显著提升稳定性。损失、基准、效率与稳定性构成一个统一的设计问题。协同求解后，得到一种兼具更高效率、更强能力与更稳定性的方案。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) finetuned for specialized domains represent crucial high-impact applications. Inference-time alignment improves safety degraded from specialization finetuning without requiring substantial computational resources, complementing finetuning-based methods with an easy-to-use, plug-and-play solution. However, existing inference-time methods fail to reliably improve safety without disrupting domain capability. We identify the root cause as complementary expertise orthogonality: specialized base models and general-domain guidance models have orthogonal competencies, making the guidance signal unreliable for specialized generation. This primarily manifests as stop token interference, where the guidance model's tendency toward continuation overrides the base model's decision to stop, burying correct answers under guidance-induced continuation. To address this problem, we propose CREST, an inference-time alignment method that steers base model hidden representations using safety directions extracted from a guidance model of any family, avoiding token-level structural limitations entirely. CREST improves safety where specialization has weakened it while preserving both domain-specific capability and the safety of already well-aligned models, outperforming baselines by up to 22.2\% on safety benchmarks. Our code is available at: https://github.com/DecayingSeart/CREST.
title: Beyond Token-Level Guidance: Inference-Time Alignment of Specialized LLMs via Cross-Family Representation Steering
title_translated: 超越词元级引导：通过跨家族表示引导实现专用大模型的推理时对齐
summary_translated: 针对特定领域微调的大语言模型代表了关键的高影响力应用。推理时对齐能够在不消耗大量计算资源的情况下改善因专业化微调而导致的安全性下降，为基于微调的方法提供了一种易于使用、即插即用的补充方案。然而，现有的推理时方法在不破坏领域能力的前提下难以可靠地提升安全性。我们识别出根本原因在于互补专长的正交性：专业化基础模型与通用领域引导模型具有正交的能力，导致引导信号对专业化生成不可靠。这主要表现为停止标记干扰，即引导模型倾向于继续生成，覆盖了基础模型本应停止的正确答案。为解决此问题，我们提出CREST，一种推理时对齐方法，通过从任意家族的引导模型中提取安全方向，引导基础模型的隐藏表示，完全避免了词元级结构限制。CREST在专业化削弱安全性的同时，保留了领域特定能力以及已有良好对齐模型的安全性，在安全基准测试中表现优于基线高达22.2%。代码可在 https://github.com/DecayingSeart/CREST 获取。

summary: Search agents reduce hallucination by grounding answers in retrieved web evidence. Yet reliance on retrieval also creates an attack surface: poisoned corpora with false or malicious documents can cause agents to reproduce misinformation. We show that falsehood is not necessary -- a search agent can be misled by factual evidence for a nearby question, adopting that nearby answer even when it does not answer the current question. We call this failure lazy grounding. We expose lazy grounding using nearby evidence from answer-changing rewrites of benchmark questions. Each document truthfully supports a neighboring rewritten question, but is surfaced for the original question. Across 12 model-benchmark pairs, nearby evidence reduces accuracy by 5.9 points on average and by up to 17.3 points, while inducing nearby-answer adoption in every setting. The effect is stronger when nearby evidence appears later or is more answer-shaped. Our results show that robust search agents must defend against not only misinformation but also the misapplication of factual evidence. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/frankyzha/lazy-grounding.
title: Lazy Grounding: Attacking Search Agents with Factual Evidence
